Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Last Impact
Game.Overview:
Super Mario 64 Last Impact, is the best hackrom game of Super Mario 64. This game has 130 stars (80 required), 12 powerups, many new bosses, and a large variety of completely new levels. Over 4000 hours of work has finally come together. Ready to enjoy the Super Mario 64 sequel, what you have asked so much?
Dificulty: 2/5

Game.Name: Super Mario 64 Maker
Game.Overview:
Kaze Emanuar is the creator of the ROM Hack known as Super Mario 64 Maker (also known as Super Mario Maker 64).
This game was inspired by the Super Mario Maker game for the Wii U, which allows users to design and share their own original Super Mario 64 levels. Super Mario 64 Maker allows players to do both (and transfering them using save states).
Beginning on July 11, 2017, as a proof of concept that Kaze demonstrated to his audience, the entire version of Super Mario 64 Maker was made available along with an accompanying movie on July 17, 2017, which was six days after the gameâ€™s first release.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Nathan Bandy
Game.Overview:
The Nathaniel Bandy Competition was the first (known) SM64 ROM hacking competition. It was hosted by SimpleFlips and received 21 submissions over the course of approximately one month.
The theme given was "Nathaniel Bandy", who is a YouTuber known for creating videos about various Super Mario games, including Super Mario 64.
'Nathan Bandy' was developed by jesusyoshi54 and finished in 4th position.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Ocarina of Time
Game.Overview: Super Mario 64: Ocarina of Time is a crossover of Mario and the world of ocarina of time. Mario will go on an adventure and collected many stars and to save Peach from Bowser who has token control over the land of Hyrule.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64 Online
Game.Overview: Super Mario 64 Online is a rom hack that makes Super Mario 64, but with online multiplayer. Up to 24 people can run around, jump and screw around. You can play with Mario, Luigi, Peach, Toad, Wario, Rosalina, and the great Waluigi, all with their own abilities.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Peach's Memory
Game.Overview: A long time ago, Princess Peach visited the Land of the Red Stars, and discovered the hidden Sanctuary of the Grand Red Star. Now, Peach cannot remember where the Sanctuary was, and entrusts Mario to find it for her..

Game.Name: Super Mario 64 Randomizer
Game.Overview: SM64 Randomizer is a ROM hack designed to create a new game every time you play. When you select a file, a "seed" is created which governs stuff such as the placement of objects in levels, the star requirements on doors and the warps to new levels. You can also pick between a large variety of different options that change the experience of your playthrough in the Options Menu!

Game.Name: Super Mario 64 Remake
Game.Overview:
Welcome back to the reimagining of Super Mario 64's castle grounds and Bob-omb Battlefield, with an extensive list of changes such as improved movest, better camera, redone healing system, new enemy behaviors, enhanced visual quality, redesigned UI and menus, many quality of life features and bug fixes, subtle context-specific details, extra stars, a settings menu, photo mode, and high quality music.
Made for Widescreen (Stretched).

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Rogue Chaos Edition
Game.Overview:
Choose your patches wisely!
Multiple Marios, crazy cameras, green demons, object shuffles, magnetic coins, periodic blindness, ad breaks, and much much more! With over 200 unique patches to choose from, every decision counts in this brand new take on Chaos Mario.
Includes 4 difficulty settings and optional "Challenge" and "Hardcore" modes with limited lives for the hardcore gamers.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Sapphire
Game.Overview: Super Mario 64: Sapphire is a carefully crafted ROM hack that showcases quality over quantity. With 30 stars spread across 4 main stages, 1 secret stage, and a challenging Bowser stage to finish, this hack offers a perfectly balanced and immersive gaming experience. Explore the vibrant world of Sapphire and discover new levels, enemies, power-ups, and challenges that will put your gaming skills to the test. Featuring updated graphics and enhanced gameplay mechanics, Super Mario 64: Sapphire is the ultimate gaming adventure for fans of the classic Super Mario franchise. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, this hack is sure to provide hours of fun and entertainment.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64 Seasons
Game.Overview: Mario 64 Seasons is a mini hack created by Nutta, with 6 Stars. It contains one course called Autumn Hills which contains six Stars to collect. The creation of this hack was commissioned by Kaze.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64 Shindou Pak Taio Version
Game.Overview: This is a 1997 re-release of Super Mario 64 with added Rumble Pak features. Part of the Japan-only Shindou Edition series.

Game.Name: SUper Mario 64: Snowy Wonderland
Game.Overview:
The Christmas Competition was a Christmas-themed SM64 ROM hacking competition hosted by SimpleFlips during 2018. It received 18 entries over the course of less than a month.
'Snowy Wonderland' was developed by luigiman0640 and finished in 4th position.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Splitscreen Multiplayer
Game.Overview: Super Mario 64 Multiplayer is a ROM hack created to make SM64 with multiplayer. Everything is not changed, but it can now be played with a friend.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: The Green Comet
Game.Overview: It is Super Mario 64, but now the green comet has joined the fray. Explore all these stages you know and love, but now with hidden green stars scattered all over the place. It could be out in the open, but difficult to get to or it could be hidden in a place you don't know about. You will have to use tricks and your skills to collect all 121 green stars. Do you have what it takes?

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: The Green Stars
Game.Overview:
Super Mario 64 The Green Stars is a ROM hack made by Kampel125 and released in 2013. Featuring 130 stars spread over 15 new levels and 7 secret levels, The Green Stars offers many interesting and well designed challenges, and is often compared to Super Mario Star Road, as a hack that feels much like the original Super Mario 64. Although it's not quite as popular as Star Road, The Green Stars is an excellent game for players just getting into ROM hacks.
The game is intended as a sequel to Super Mario 64, and also makes references to Super Mario Galaxy. Once again, Bowser has stolen the stars and used their power to create an army of monsters and kidnap Princess Peach. The Toads built a rocket to take Mario to Bowser, but Bowser locked it before Mario could get there, so the rocket serves as the first key-door of the game. The ending cutscene is the same as in the original game, though with minor changes.
Also listed in the credits for hacking and help are Kaze Emanuar, Frauber, and VL-Tone.
Not related to Super Mario 64: The Green Comet

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: The Missing Stars
Game.Overview:
Super Mario 64 The Missing Stars is the first official major ROM hack of Super Mario 64 ever created. It was initially released in April 2009 and contains 38 Stars.
In terms of difficulty, it is relatively straightforward, and in terms of length, it is quite short and not very cryptic. It is also one of the most unique hacks, making use of a large number of interesting and unique gimmicks in every one of its "levels". The format of the hack is also different, as most of the stars are not found in standard courses, but in small overworld areas. These areas are all large, flat areas with objects such as platforms put into them, which Mario or Luigi must traverse to reach Stars or coins.
This hack strives on changes during gameplay and progression through the hack. Oddly, the camera seems to focus on the center of the level when on Lakitu Cam, so using the Mario perspective is recommended. Beware that the various pipes and sections will change the camera. On a side note, the character selection and the final boss both require use of the directional pad, specifically the left and right inputs; because of this, you may need to ensure that you have these controls mapped.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: The Slideverse
Game.Overview: This hack aims to recreate SM64 vanilla levels in form of slides. The player has to overcome all the various challanges, often inspired by elements present in the original game, in order to reach the final goal and obtain their 'shiny prize', through a survival mode with limited lives.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Through the Ages
Game.Overview: Mario visits various historical locations while teaming up with various partner Pokemon. This ROM hack of Super Mario 64 features 95 stars to find.

Game.Name: Super Mario 64: Trouble Town
Game.Overview: This is a rom-hack made by Nobbie that contains 30 Stars located across 4 levels and 2 secret stages

Game.Name: Super Mario 74
Game.Overview:
Super Mario 74 is a ROM hack created by Lugmillord. It was released in June 2011 and contains 151 Stars.
This hack is one of the most popular hacks and received high reviews worldwide during its development until the official release. While being the first full-length hack of its time to compete against Super Mario Star Road, Super Mario 74 steps itself away as a unofficial sequel to Super Mario 64 featuring new custom worlds, music tracks and textures (although the same textures are sourced from the original).
The plot is explained by a Toad close to Mario's starting point in the Valley of the Toads, which is the first overworld. As usual, Princess Peach has been kidnapped by Bowser. This time, however, there are a total of 151 Stars to collect- allegedly, these extra 30 Stars happened to be hidden in a toilet during the events of Super Mario 64. In Super Mario 74, these 30 Stars are placed throughout the overworlds and in the secret stages.
Also, once you get to the final two levels, Mario learns of the Kubus(es), which are cubes that control certain aspects of every video game in existence. Though there are five in total, only two are introduced as levels. The Kubus of Light provides energy for sunlight in every video game, and the Kubus of Darkness produces all of the darkness in every video game.

Game.Name: Super Mario 74: Extreme Edition
Game.Overview:
Super Mario 74 Extreme Edition (SM74EE for short) is a ROM hack made by Lugmillord. and released on Christmas 2012. It is the sequel of Super Mario 74, featuring 157 Stars, and the majority of the levels from the original hack are present. However, a lot of them have been altered, mirrored and redesigned to be extremely difficult, such as underwater sections and even solid ground being replaced by excessive lava falls or bottomless pits.
It was considered to be the hardest Super Mario 64 hack ever, until Star Revenge 2: Night of Doom came out in July 2013, just over half a year after this hack's release. It was then to be considered the second hardest SM64 hack in existence, just below Night of Doom, but since then most of the kaizo hacks have surpassed their difficulty level. Overall, Super Mario 74 Extreme Edition is widely acclaimed as the most popular difficult ROM hack in the SM64 ROM Hack community, and pioneered the extreme hack genre (later to be named kaizo).
There are also even harder joke "object edits" of this hack called "SM74EEEE", "SM74EEEEEE" (etc.), though they are not made by Lugmillord and only move objects around without changing any level geometry.

Game.Name: Super Mario 74: Ten Years After
Game.Overview:
After saving Princess Peach from Bowser's evil clutches and stopping an extreme disaster, peace has returned in the Mushroom Kingdom. While its restoration process is underway, Mario notices that something is off around the worlds and is investigating the changes. Could this be Bowser taking revenge, or, some strange phenomenon about to spread across the kingdom once again?
Super Mario 74: Ten Years After is a major ROM Hack created by Mariocrash (also known as LinCrash on Twitch). Released on January 2021, this hack is a crossover of both Lugmillord's Super Mario 74 and its Extreme Edition counterpart, which introduces newer themes for the levels, as well as newer missions. It was made to celebrate Super Mario 74's 10th anniversary ever since its official release.
According to the title itself, this hack is the 3rd game of the series, which takes place 10 years later after the events of Extreme Edition; meaning that the levels are no longer devilishly difficult, although some are harder to their predecessors from a visual aspect. While all of this is exclusive, the levels are mirrored again and fewer extras that weren't in both hacks have been included.
The new update, Deluxe Edition, released around the day of Super Mario 74's full release, features extra QoL enhancements, polished design changes and the 2 newly reworked Sphere levels as a mark to tone the game's difficulty down for blind/casual-friendly and experienced players alike.

Game.Name: Super Mario 74: The Twelve Year Comet
Game.Overview: Super Mario 74: The Twelve Year Comet is a major ROM hack created by Mariocrash, and in collaboration with Ozsef. This hack is the green comet extension of Ten Years After. The gameplay is similar to the original hack but very few changes and easter eggs were added. There are 101 Green Stars in total and they are found to be quite intricate. Reading signs are required in order to collect specific Stars.

Game.Name: Super Mario and the Cursed Castles
Game.Overview:
Super Mario and the Cursed Castles is a major ROM hack created by Foxen, having 121 Stars (as of v1.01) to collect spread over 15 courses and a few extra levels.
It is known for being one of the few major hacks to have the Wing, Vanish and Metal Caps completely absent, and for having large (but not empty) levels to explore. The hack's difficulty was intended to be as similar to the original game as possible, thus making it an excellent hack to play for those who are new to playing ROM hacks of Super Mario 64.

Game.Name: Super Mario and the Grand Star
Game.Overview:
Super Mario and the Grand Star is a ROM hack created by Grand Star and released in 2020. It features over 15 levels and 116 Stars.
This game is set to take place after the events of Super Mario 64 and shortly before the events of Super Mario Sunshine.
Bowser and his minions have gone to war with the Mushroom Kingdom, though the tides of the war are constantly shifting. To help shift the war in his direction, Bowser travels to the Moon in search of a prophesied ancient relic known as the Grand Star. The situation goes from bad to worse when Bowser awakens Khonsu, one of the last surviving members of an alien civilization. Khonsu seems to think the people of Earth killed his people many years ago, and vows to destroy the Earth to get revenge. It's now up to Mario to save the world from Khonsu!

Game.Name: Super Mario and the Monstrous Manor
Game.Overview: Mario gets invited to explore a haunted manor in this unconventionally-structured major hack. Solve puzzles, collect keys, and fight enemies to uncover the mystery of the manor

Game.Name: Super Mario Bros. 64
Game.Overview:
Super Mario Bros. 64 is a rom hack made by Kaze Emanuar that recreates the original NES Super Mario Bros. using the Super Mario 64 engine. It features thirty-two reimagined levels from SMB, and three power-ups faithfully recreated. There are four playable characters including Mario, Luigi, Wario and Waluigi, each one of them has different jump heights.
*Plot* Mario, his brother Luigi, Wario and his partner Waluigi travel to the Mushroom Kingdom to rescue Princess Peach from the main antagonist, Bowser. They must traverse side-scrolling stages while avoiding hazards such as enemies and pits with the aid of power-ups such as the Super Mushroom, Fire Flower and Starman. Completing the final level "World 8-4" will activate the ending sequence, which shows a picture of Princess Peach with the word "Thank You!" accompanying it.

Game.Name: Super Mario Fallen Stars
Game.Overview:
The game features four colorful levels and 45 Stars.
All three Cap Switches are sitting out in the open in the overworld. The Toad in the overworld refers to Bowser's Ice Mountain as "Bowser's Lair" but Bowser does not make an appearance in this game.

Game.Name: Super Mario Meltdown
Game.Overview: Super Mario Meltdown is a ROM hack of Super Mario 64 featuring 60 Power Stars! Face a threatening Bowser who seeks to open evil portals across the Mushroom Kingdom using the power of the Stars! Collect all 60 Power Stars to stop him and save the kingdom! Explore over 30 unique and varied maps, with custom and original mechanics! All of it backed by immersive music to fully draw you into the world of Super Mario Meltdown. Princess Peach is waiting for you!

Game.Name: Super Mario Odyssey 64
Game.Overview: Modder, Kaze Emanuar released Super Mario 64 â€˜demakeâ€™ of Super Mario Odyssey for the Nintendo 64. The project incorporates Cappy as part of Marioâ€™s powers, letting him assume direct control of Goombas, Bullet Bills, Pokios, and more. Emanuar says the mod includes 80 moons to collect.

Game.Name: Super Mario Rainbow Road
Game.Overview: This hack contains 60 stars of classic platforming across half a dozen custom stages and secret stages, featuring new objects and ASM code.

Game.Name: Super Mario: Star Road
Game.Overview: Super Mario: Star Road is a Rom hack made by Skelux. It was released around Christmas 2011, and contains 130 Stars. This Rom hack is one of the best and most well-known Rom hacks out there. This is due to the similarities to Mario 64 in terms of difficulty and game play, as well as some of the best level design for a ROM hack today.

Game.Name: Super Mario Star Road Multiplayer
Game.Overview: SMSR Multiplayer was created to make the popular ROM hack, Super Mario Star Road, with multiplayer. Everything has not been changed, but now with multiplayer.

Game.Name: Super Mario: Star Road Retooled
Game.Overview: Super Mario: Star Road retooled is an overhauled reassembly of Star Road, featuring many enhancements and technical upgrades from the original! Contains many design alterations intended to improve the experience.

Game.Name: Super Mario Star Road: The Green Comet
Game.Overview:
Super Mario Star Road: The Green Comet is a hack made by Skelux and biobak. It was released in January 2021, and is based on Super Mario Star Road. It follows Super Mario Galaxy 2's concept of Green Stars, which are placed in tricky locations in already existing levels.
The hack contains 150 Stars, of which 15 can only be accessed after the other 135 have been collected. They replace Star Road's golden Stars, are placed in different locations, and are often harder to reach. Enemies and bosses have been removed from levels, and there many more NPCs than the base game. These NPCs give tips to the player or contribute to the game's lore.
All of the game's levels can be accessed right from the start, as doors no longer require Stars or keys.
When 135 Stars have been collected, green coins will appear in every main course, allowing access to the final 15 Stars and the true ending of the game.
The game has no life counter, since the player has infinite lives. 1-UP mushrooms are replaced by Comet Medals, which are not required and do nothing but offer an optional challenge to the players who wish to test their skills in platforming, knowledge of the game or observation.

Game.Name: Super Mega Man 64
Game.Overview: Play through the classic Mario levels as Mega Man

Game.Name: Super Melee Adventure 64
Game.Overview:
Super Melee Adventure 64 is a rom hack by Pasta Power. This Super Mario 64 Mod replicates The Adventure Mode from Super Smash Bros. Melee.
It features six different levels based off several levels featured in Adventure Mode of Super Smash Bros. Melee. There are six Stars that need to be collected by completing various tasks, whether itâ€™s collect eight red coins in Corneria or beat up a bunch of Pikachuâ€™s to get enough coins for a Star.

Game.Name: Super Robot Spirits
Game.Overview:
Super Robot Spirits is a one-against-one fighting game featuring big robots from the Super Robot Wars game series and anime TV series. The background story is basically about an mysterious force attacking Earth and the robot pilots battle it out to determine who fights the evil robots in the end. How the story plays out in detail depends on which of the seven characters is used in story mode. The selectable characters are the protagonists' mecha from the series Daitarn 3, Dancougar, G Gundam, Dunbine, Xabungle and Voltes V plus the R-1 from Shin Super Robot Taisen. By meeting certain conditions while playing, three more characters can be unlocked, including one that makes its debut in this game.
The gameplay itself follows the genre standards: both opponents can perform a set of standard and special attacks (the latter executed with certain button combinations). Every hit causes the energy bar to go down and whoever runs out first, loses. When a timer runs out, the one with the most energy left wins. Each fighter also has a second energy meter which can be used to perform especially powerful attacks. The robots also can fly which changes the available attack range. The playing modes are story, vs (two players), 64 (same as story mode without the story), Guts (fighting one opponent after another until the energy runs out), time attack (defeating opponents in a short time) and training.

Game.Name: Super Robot Taisen 64
Game.Overview:
The basic concept remains unchanged in this N64 installment of the series - it's a turned based strategy game where the player commands robots and pilots from various Japanese shows, for example Dancouga and different Gundam series, as well as Banpresto originals. Newly introduced are Six God Combination Godmars, Giant Robo and Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team.
At the beginning of the game, the player is offered a choice out of four pairs of protagonists/rivals, which affects the plot and the stages played. With the different variations included, there are over 100 missions.
During the stages, the player moves his units over a map, attacking enemies and using special abilities. When getting attacked, player units may defend, counter, or attempt to evade, resulting in no damage at all if successful. Destroyed enemies give experience and money for upgrading between the missions. Often, scripted events happen, such as reinforcements arriving. Sometimes it's also possible to persuade certain characters to join the player's side, in addition to those that join automatically. Certain, otherwise unobtainable units, can also be unlocked by using the N64 Transfer Pak in combination with the Gameboy Color game Super Robot Wars: Link Battler.

Game.Name: Super Smash Bros.
Game.Overview:
Super Smash Bros. takes familiar Nintendo characters such as Mario, Kirby and Donkey Kong, and gets them to fight to the death. There are 8 fully-interactive landscapes, with one for each character, with noticeable links to their games. Controls are analogue-based, with different moves executed depending on the direction and how firmly the stick is pressed. Items like baseball bats, Bob-ombs, and healing items drop into the arenas at random, aiding any nearby characters than can make use of them. The game uses a fixed viewpoint which scrolls, although characters are rendered in 3D.
The one-player mode has 14 stages to work through. Up to 4 human players can do battle at once, with team play as well as all-against-all action. Hidden characters are thrown in for good measure, as are bonus rounds, and a battle to the end with a giant hand.

Game.Name: Super Smash Bros. 3D
Game.Overview: Super Smash Bros. 3D is a ROM hack of Super Mario 64 that changes all the levels into levels from Smash Bros. 64 and Melee and gives Mario and Luigi all of their moves from Smash Bros as well.

Game.Name: Super Smash Kart
Game.Overview: Super Smash Kart is a Mario Kart 64 ROM Hack created by Goofydudeguya. It introduces a new interface, new characters including Link, Kirby and Captain Falcon, and brand new courses including Gerudo Fortress and Zebes Sprint from Metroid.

Game.Name: Super Sonic 2 Bros.
Game.Overview:
SONIC 2 Mod for Super Smash Brothers 64 Version 1: 11/10/2020 by: Ownsoldier
List of Changes (version 1):
â€¢ New title splash screen â€¢ New menu background and music from Sonic 2 competition results â€¢ Player select music from Sonic 2 options screen â€¢ Data music from Hidden Palace Zone
â€¢ **All stage select images and text reworked to fit each level*** â€¢ Peachâ€™s Castle is now Emerald Hill Zone â€¢ Congo Jungle is now Mystic Cave Zone (includes barrel hazard) â€¢ Hyrule Castle is now Aquatic Ruin Zone â€¢ Planet Zebes is now Chemical Plant Zone (includes rising lava hazard) â€¢ Mushroom Kingdom is now Green Hills Zone (from the Sega Game Gear game â€¢ Sonic 2) â€¢ Yoshiâ€™s Island is now Wing Fortress Zone (includes walkable clouds) â€¢ Kirbyâ€™s Dreamland is now Hill Top Zone (includes wind blowing hazard) â€¢ Sector Z is now Metropolis Zone (includes arwing hazard) â€¢ Saffron City is now Casino Night Zone â€¢ Starman item has Sonic 2â€™s invincibility music â€¢ Hammer item has Sonic 2â€™s Super Sonic music â€¢ New results screen background and music
â€¢ **Single player levels changes*** â€¢ Tutorial stages have custom background and music from Sky Chase Zone â€¢ Break targets and board platforms have special stage background and music â€¢ New music for all completion and fail results screens â€¢ Metal Mario Stage is now Oil Ocean Zone â€¢ Fighting Polygon Stage is now Death Egg Zone â€¢ Master Hand Stage has Final Zone background and music â€¢ Ending credits have the Sonic 2 ending cinematic music

Game.Name: Super Sonic Bros.
Game.Overview:
Version 2: 5/14/2020 Here are the additions in the new updateâ€¦
â€¢ Bridge Zone (Mushroom Kingdom) now has custom textures and models. (note: The warp pipes and POW blocks have been removed). Melody synth volume in the music has been turned down. â€¢ Special Stage (Yoshiâ€™s Stage, multi and 1p) now have custom textures and models. â€¢ Casino Night Zone (Saffron City) now has custom textures and models. (note: The moving platforms have been disabled and the pokemon spawn offscreen, itâ€™s necessary to keep them or the level crashes) â€¢ Hidden palace music from Sonic 2 added to Character bios and VS record screen â€¢ Some levels have been re-optimized for better four-player performance
- Version 1: 4/27/2020 Thanks to the efforts of the amazing N64 hackers who developed the â€œgoldeneye setup editorâ€, ownsoldier has been able to put his very limited hacking skills to work to cook up this mod that recreates SONIC 1 levels and music in SSB64. Ownsoldier has reworked every possible level that he could without causing the game to crash or glitch on emulator AND ON CONSOLE (Everdrive 64 version 3.0). That means that all model poly-counts, textures, and music are kept within their respective boundaries to keep the framerate and processing speed consistent with the original game, some stages have even slightly improved performance. ALL the custom music has been reworked BY HAND down to every instrument and every note.
List of Changes:
â€¢ New title splash screen â€¢ New menu background and music from Sonic 2 competition results â€¢ Player select music from Sonic 2 options screen â€¢ All stage select images and text reworked to fit each level: â€¢ Peachâ€™s Castle is now Green Hill Zone â€¢ Congo Jungle is now Spring Yard Zone (includes barrel hazard) â€¢ Planet Zebes is now Marble Zone (includes rising lava hazard) â€¢ Hyrule Castle is now Labyrinth Zone (includes tornado hazards) â€¢ Yoshiâ€™s Island only includes the Special Stage background and music â€¢ Sector Z is now Scrap Brain Zone (includes arwing hazards, wish models could be changed to badniks!) â€¢ Kirbyâ€™s Dreamland is now Star Light Zone (includes wind blowing hazard) â€¢ Saffron City only includes Sonic 2â€™s Casino Night background and music â€¢ Mushroom Kingdom only includes Bridge Zone background and music (from the Sega Game Gear game Sonic 1) â€¢ Starman item has Sonic 1â€™s invincibility music â€¢ Hammer item has Sonic 2â€™s Super Sonic music â€¢ New results screen background and music â€¢ Single player levels changes: â€¢ Break targets and board platforms have special stage background and music â€¢ New music for all completion and fail results screens â€¢ Fighting Polygon Stage is now the Battlefield version of Scrap Brain â€¢ Metal Mario Stage is now Scrap Brain Act 3 with Boss music â€¢ Master Hand Stage has Final Zone background and music â€¢ Ending credits have the Sonic 1 ending music

Game.Name: Super Waluigi 64
Game.Overview: Waluigi joins the world of Super Mario 64!

Game.Name: Super Wario 64
Game.Overview:
This is a slightly unfinished Wario moveset based off of Wario World that I'm working on for a Wario Land 64 mod I want to make. It's missing the wild swing ding from Wario World and picking up nearly every enemy in the game like in Wario Land 1-5. I might update this from time to time and improve it.
Credit to FluffaLuigi for the Wario model that I extended for this mod. Made with HackerSM64.

Game.Name: Susume! Taisen Puzzle Dama: Toukon! Marutama Chou
Game.Overview:
Susume! Taisen Puzzle Dama: Toukon! Marutama Chou is a collection of three games:
â€¢ A falling block puzzle with similarities to Puyo Puyo. Blocks fall down in pairs of two which can be rotated. Matching three or more blocks cause them to disappear.
â€¢ The second puzzle game is a tile matching game with similarities to Tetris Attack. Blocks rise from the bottom of the screen and the player's job is to arrange them so three or more of the same color are next to each other which causes them to disappear. To do so, the player controls a cursor which is used to swap two blocks.
â€¢ The third game is a bowling variant. Here the player just sets the speed and direction of the bowling ball. If an ideal angle is met, the player character performs a special attack which clears all pins.

Game.Name: Sydney 2000
Game.Overview: Sydney 2000 is the official video game of the XXVII Olympic Summer Games, hosted by Sydney, Australia in 2000. Developed by Attention to Detail and published by Eidos, it was released for the Sony PlayStation, PC (Microsoft Windows) and the Sega Dreamcast. Ports of the game for Nintendo 64 and Game Boy Color was planned for release alongside the PlayStation version but was later canceled. With a total of 32 countries and 12 events, it was the follow-up of Olympic Summer Games: Atlanta '96.

Game.Name: Takua 64
Game.Overview:
Takua 64 is a major total conversion mod for Super Mario 64 created by Superstupidy to bring the world of Bionicle into the N64 3D platforming era!
With environment and level design inspired by games like Metroid Prime, Tomb Raider, and of course, the many Bionicle games that had a huge influence on this gameâ€™s world: MNOG, MNOGII, Bionicle the Game, The Legend of Mata Nui, and Tales of the Tohunga being primary examples.
With 99 â€œToa Stonesâ€ to find and collect, Takua 64 is a very large romhack feturing 12 levels, each with multiple areas to explore and challenges to overcome.
Takua 64 is aimed at pleasing (hopefully) Bionicle fans with little to no SM64 experience as well as SM64 veterans with its difficulty.

Game.Name: Tamiya Racing 64
Game.Overview:
Tamiya Racing 64 is a tech demo for a racing game (presumably the similarly unreleased Mini Racers) with licensed remote-controlled cars, featuring very sensitive controls and vacuum cleaner engine sounds. It was developed by Intermetrics, associated with Looking Glass Studios.
The cartridge containing this prototype surfaced as an eBay auction in early 2012 and was sold for $1,358. It was dumped and released by Team CARROT on April 5 of that year.

Game.Name: TankBond
Game.Overview:
TankBond is a ROM Hack of GoldenEye 007, with the following premise (per the hack creator):
You enter the tank at the start of the level and can't exit the tank. You are given tank ammo on every stage except Archives and Bunker 2. You can pick up items and ammo like a normal play through.
The tank is scaled down quite a bit. Clipping code has been modified, the tank bounding box is smaller than the model. The stan navigation code has also been modified to use a hybrid between the tank code and bond code. You can drive up ramps/stairs and warp up and down ladders.
Minimum lower angle in the tank has been lowered to -40 degrees from -20. You can rotate the tank slightly faster now.

Game.Name: Tarzan
Game.Overview: Overcome the jungle's most dangerous perils in this action-packed adventure. Based on the animated film, Tarzan allows you to relive Tarzan's journey through life from a headstrong youth to a courageous adult. Your innate jungle abilities will allow you to swing, climb, run, jump, and surf through 13 beautiful environments, while interacting with unique characters, riding elephants, and solving challenging puzzles. It's now up to you to master the moves of this unique jungle hero and save Tarzan's family from a ruthless hunter.

Game.Name: Taz Express
Game.Overview:
Taz - a delivery boy? Would you trust THIS guy to deliver your fragile package?
Tired of seeing Taz do nothing but hang around the house and watch TV, She-Devil decides Taz needs to find a job. She finds the perfect one for him - as a delivery boy for the next courier service, "Taz Express". Your job: Help Taz protect the package long enough to deliver it.

Game.Name: Telocation: Gemini
Game.Overview: Telocation: Gemini is a Nintendo 64 homebrew game by Team Ultra Rare and released on 13 December 2020. In it, you control a crashlanded space cadet that befriends a robot and who work together to gather gems and escape the planet. This game was made for the 64brew game jam 2020, and won 1st place.

Game.Name: Tetris 64
Game.Overview:
Tetris 64 is a puzzle game for the Nintendo 64. It was released only in Japan in 1998 despite the whole game being in English. It is the only Nintendo 64 game that can make use of the Nintendo 64's bio sensor which was included with the game.
The game itself offers the traditional Tetris experience: Blocks enter the screen from the top of the screen and can be moved and rotated as long as they are falling. The goal is to create full lines which then disappear, reward points and cause the game to become more difficult over time. The game is lost when the appearing stone can't be moved anymore because the screen is full. B-Type is similar but the screen gets filled with random block combinations from the ground.
In addition to this standard mode, the game features two unique variants: In "Giga Tetris" the player occasionally has to deal with huge blocks which break up when touching the ground. "Bio Tetris" makes use of the bio sensor accessory: it is clipped into the user's ear and measures the heart rate. It can be set if the game slows down or speeds up when the heart rate rises.

Game.Name: Tetrisphere
Game.Overview: What would you do if your friends were trapped at the core of a sphere layered in hundreds of Tetris pieces? You'd have a BLAST! Tetrisphere is a whole new way to play Tetris, the world's most popular home video puzzle game. Explore over 300 levels of unique 3D gameplay charged with high voltage action. Choose to take control of Wheels, Jak, Rocket, Gear, Turbine or Stomp to experience 3D puzzle excitement like never before!

Game.Name: Thamz in a Wheelchair
Game.Overview: Face off against the creator of Paper Mario: Master Quest in a fierce battle!

Game.Name: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: Gruntilda's Mask
Game.Overview: Gruntilda has found the Majora Mask and, using a powerful spell, has created an ever dearlier item, the Gruntilda's Mask. Explore the secrets of Clock Town and find the way to climb to the top of the Clock Tower... CONTENT: -100 Notes -20 Jiggies -18 Honeycomb Pieces -20 Mumbo Tokens and more...

Game.Name: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: The Bear Waker
Game.Overview: -King of Red Lions is waiting for Link to go in search of her sister and defeat the evil Ganondorf, but it seems he is delaying and for some strange reason the door of his house is locked. So Banjo and Kazooie should like to explore Outset Island in search of clues to be able to find a way to open the door of his house and find out what could have happened...

Game.Name: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: The Bear Waker Deluxe
Game.Overview:
Bear Waker Deluxe was released as an updated version of Mark Kurko's original Bear Waker mod, approximately 5 years after its original release.
Updates from the original version: * Several bugs fixed * Several extra maps * More than 10 new songs * Added an extra Minigame discarded from Jiggies of Time * 10 Jiggies have been added (+ 1 extra final Jiggy) Total: 21 * 5 more Mumbo Tokens. Total: 20 * 10 more Empty honeycombs. Total: 12 * Reduced the notes to 125 to fix a bug in the Select file screen note counting * More dialogues and previous dialogues rewritten * And more surprises...

Game.Name: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: The Jiggies of Time
Game.Overview:
In the game, you play as Banjo and Kazooie, a bear and a bird tasked with stopping the evil witch Gruntilda by hoarding a bunch of random shiny stuff scattered around puzzle-like platforming environments. The twist here, though, is that these environments are full, extensive, recreations of Hyrule from Ocarina of Time loaded with in-jokes from Nintendo's storied past.
The game is lovingly made, with detail and charm to spare. For example, the music consists of classic Zelda compositions but remade with Banjo-Kazooie's instrument set. Absolutely inspired! That's the kind of touch usually reserved for official collaborations like Cadence of Hyrule. Death Mountain, Kakariko Village, The Lost Woods, Kokiri Forest â€” they're all here and gorgeously remade and tweaked to fit the new style of gameplay. You'll travel to nine worlds with 100 Jiggies, 900 musical notes, countless eggs, Jinjos, Honeycomb pieces and more, all the while stumbling onto Easter Eggs that I can't in good conscience spoil for you. There are even custom Mumbo transformations!
Game.WikipediaURL: Banjo Kazooie: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: The Jiggies of Time

Game.Name: The Legend of Peach
Game.Overview: In a parallel universe where Hyrule doesnâ€™t exist, Zelda is kidnapped by Ganon in her own castle. It is up for our hero, Link, to find all the Golden Skulltula Tokens and save the princess!

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Child Quest
Game.Overview:
Experience the story of Ocarina of Time without ever reaching adulthood. All items are usuable and every collectable can be acquired. Riding Epona, doing both trading quests, pulling the Master Swordâ€¦ Hidden surprises included!
Included with the download are standalone BPS variants for:
-Original dungeons -Master Quest dungeons -Ura Quest (MQ Beta) dungeons

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Crystal Clocks
Game.Overview:
Itâ€™s a beautiful night, and youâ€™re headed off to stargaze with Saria and Mido. Surely, the path to get there is simple!
Take aim with the Dragshot, a modified slingshot with a creeping twist. Complete 11 different puzzle rooms as you manage platform switches and crystal activation sequences. Puzzles are primarily time-based, so being able to maintain patience and tolerate precise aiming is key. Estimated completion time is one hour.
Looking for an extra challenge? Scattered around the level are four optional Pieces of Hearts. Stay alert for a special hint system that will help you find them all.
This mod was originally submitted as an entry for Hylian Moddingâ€™s first competition.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Demon's Quest
Game.Overview:
Ocarina of Time: Demonâ€™s Quest is a gameplay mod that aims to make the game more challenging to the experienced player.
Features include:
-New enemy attacks -Trial of Courage: A Savage Labyrinth-esque gauntlet of enemies required to obtain Double Defense. - RPG style leveling: Strength, intelligence, endurance, and luck will bolster your stats in combat. -Hero Mode: Challenge yourself in this mode where damage is tripled and drained heart containers can no longer be recovered. Ever. Try not to lose them all. -Shield Durability: Consider dodging. Shields can be re-bought at a shop. -Perfect Block: Donâ€™t want to lose stamina? Donâ€™t want to lose durability? Donâ€™t want to take damage? Now you can have it all. -Stamina: Every combat action you take drains stamina. No longer can you mindlessly swing your sword about and win. -Life Drain: Upon death, a heart container is drained from your life. Consult the Great Fairies for aid. -Double Damage: Those Deku Babas arenâ€™t playing anymore. -Potions: Drinking a potion no longer pauses the game.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Dungeon Rush
Game.Overview: This hack is exactly like its name, there are only dungeons, if you try to leave the dungeon you will return to it automatically. After researching the hack, I realized that the creator of this hack created it exactly to do speedruns, there are several improvements and some item changes that make the hack very good

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Fate of the Bombiwa
Game.Overview: You have been tasked with aiding the Bombiwa Tribe with the missing personâ€™s investigation. What will this task lead you to? The fate of the Bombiwa is in your hands.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Gold Quest
Game.Overview:
Gold Quest is like an expanded Master Quest. Different dungeon & overworld layouts plus many other little gameplay changes.
Designed with the more experienced OOT player in mind & for those who like to complete 100% of the game. Like Master Quest, itâ€™s the same story, although there are some text changes & cutscenes have generally been made shorter. Text speed has been increased. Dungeon Maps have all been updated for new chest locations with fast chest openings. The intro has been removed (you start in Linkâ€™s house).

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ice Arrow Is Missing
Game.Overview:
Ice Arrow is Missing is a puzzle hack where the Ice Arrow has been hidden some where in the game and cryptic clues have been left behind that lead to it's location. The clues can mean a range of things: from a specific time of day, the amount of a specific object in a room, or to certain events that happen in the game. It's up to the player to solve the clues and get back what is rightfully theirs!
The clues are not necessarily restricted to Majora's Mask specifically. What this means is that clues could possibly be a phrase or a saying used in every day life. A clue could be something from a book, film, song lyric or anything at all! Generally when clues like this are used a specific word or words will be highlighted to signify they are more important.
Every Part of IAIM are their own unique puzzle. No two Parts are alike. Just because the player may solve one does not necessarily mean they will be able to solve another.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
Game.Overview:
Linkâ€™s all-new epic adventure lands him in the mystical world of Termina, where ever-present clocks count down the hours until a menacing moon falls from the sky above. When his horse and Ocarina are stolen by a strange, masked figure, Link embarks on an urgent quest to solve the mystery of the moon, save the world from destruction, and find his way back to the peaceful land of Hyrule!
* Link transforms before your eyes--Over 20 magical masks give Link powers and abilities heâ€™s never had before! Watch him transform into a hapless Deku child, a mighty Goron hero and a legendary Zora guitarist. * Race against time--Characters and events flow with the hours of the day. Set your own schedule and even alter time itself in a race to stop the moon and save the world! * Panoramic environments! Powered-up action battles! Fully interactive characters and events! Experience gorgeous rendered landscapes, swarms of attacking enemies and a deep, engrossing world of wonders with the power of the N64 Expansion Pak.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask Master Quest
Game.Overview: Majora's Mask Master Quest is a ROM hack that aims to do something similar to its Ocarina of Time counterpart: change around the dungeons to make the game challenging in a different way. Some over-world areas were also changed.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Master of Time
Game.Overview:
After saving both Hyrule and Termina, Link found himself without a quest. He journeyed long and far without knowing what to do. He thought a lot about the time manipulation he had done and asked himself if he was the real hero or if he was just a victim of these stories.
The more his obsession of time had grown, the more it felt that time was slowing downâ€¦ Until it froze completely, condemning his journey to an endless dayâ€¦ Just before passing out from exhaustion, Link finally found a new countryâ€¦
Master of Time is a new story in a completely new world, Abello, where Link must restore the flow of time. Abello is a big and dangerous world, but Link can count on the help of Nite the fairy.
Around 20 hours of gameplay in various areas and dungeons with custom cutscenes, songs and much more. Good luck finding all 100 skulltula tokens and 20 hearts!

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Nimpize Adventure
Game.Overview: Nimpize Adventure tells Taels story of the hero that woke from the flooded tomb. It includes modified areas, completely new maps, and some easter eggs.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Game.Overview:
Ganondorf, the evil King of Thieves, is on the move, threatening the peaceful land of Hyrule. He is determined to steal his way into the legendary Sacred Realm in hopes of harnessing the power of the mythical Triforce. As the young hero Link, it is your destiny to thwart Ganondorfâ€™s evil schemes. Navi, your guardian fairy, will guide you as you venture through the many regions of Hyrule, from the volcanic caves of Death Mountain to the treacherous waters of Zoraâ€™s Domain. Before you complete this epic quest, youâ€™ll delve into deadly dungeons, collect weapons of great power and learn the spells you need to conquer the most irresistible force of all-time.
* The immersive storyline and environments draw players into an amazing 3D world. * Time travel allows you to play as Link in different stages of his life. * New gameplay features include a unique targeting system and 1st and 3rd person perspectives. * Up to three games can be saved simultaneously to memory!

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time: 4 Player Edition
Game.Overview: A ROM hack of OOT that adds local co-op, enabling up to 4 Players to each control their own Link.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time: Expansion Disk
Game.Overview:
Zelda Expansion Disk is a ROM hack created by ZethN64.
These are the original 64DD dungeons that Master Quest is based from. There are differences, between the layouts and puzzles.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time: Four Swords Arena Edition
Game.Overview: This mod allows you to play by yourself or up to 4 players as you play through a few small dungeons in Ocarina of Time. It features a top down view.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time + Majora's Mask Randomizer
Game.Overview: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time + Majora's Mask Randomizer (OoTMM) is a randomizer for the N64 games Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask. It combines both games into a single rom and randomizes the placement of most items in the games. A large number of settings are available to customize the experience.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Master Quest
Game.Overview: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Master Quest is a reworked version of the original Ocarina of Time for the Nintendo 64. Master Quest contains largely the same content as the original Ocarina of Time, but with redesigned, more difficult dungeons akin to a Second Quest. This game is an unofficial port from the original GameCube version.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - New Master Quest
Game.Overview:
A difficult Master Questâ€“style romhack that preserves the original gameplay experience while adding redesigned dungeons, harder enemies, and various quality of life improvements.
New Master Quest recreates the experience of playing Ocarina of Time again with a fresh challenge.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Spaceworld '97 BETA Experience
Game.Overview: Experience a rare behind-the-scenes look at one of the most beloved games of all time! This is a mod of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time that aims to recreate the demo that attendees of Nintendo Space World in 1997 would have experienced. From areas to dialogue to textures, the beta of Ocarina of Time has been carefully and accurately recreated.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time: Space World '97 Beta Experience
Game.Overview: This project aims to be a mostly accurate representation of the Nintendo Spaceworld 1997 demo of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Since this project aims to restore an experience that was originally a demo, it cannot be completed from start-to-finish like the final game. Instead, three gameplay â€œtoursâ€ featured in the original Spaceworld 1997 demo are available to choose from, each showcasing various unique flavors of gameplay.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time with Triforce% Quest
Game.Overview: For years fans have speculated about the mysteries contained within Ocarina of Time. People wondered if you really could play the Overture of Sages. How do you melt the ice in Zora's Domain? Could one legitimately beat the Running Man? Where is the fabled Unicorn Fountain? Can you get the Triforce in Ocarina of Time? For years, sometimes with questionable evidence, debates were had on forums like GameFAQs. Many peopleâ€™s consensus was no. However, 23 years later, through the work of some incredibly talented and dedicated individuals, the answer is yes! The original demonstration of this content, Triforce Percent OoT ACE Showcase was performed on an unmodified NTSC-U v1.0 cartridge of The Legend of Zelda: The Ocarina of Time using original hardware. Now, the public can enjoy a brand-new adventure that focuses on the lost content in Ocarina of Time. Unlock the secrets of Hyrule as Link and: â€¢ Play the full Song of Time! â€¢ Power up your masks! â€¢ Heat it up in Zora's Domain! â€¢ Discover the Running Manâ€™s Secret! â€¢ Obtain the Sacred Triforce! Download at https://github.com/triforce-percent/triforce-percent and play today!

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Petrie's Challenge
Game.Overview: Step into the world of Hyrule like never before with Petrieâ€™s Challenge, a heavily modified demo based on The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Puzzling
Game.Overview:
Traverse through six challenging trials in this mod made by DezZival! Made for Ocarina of Time 1.0, you are tasked with solving a variety of puzzles that will surely stump you.
Will you triumph through these challenges, or will you become too puzzled to continue on?

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ruinous Shards
Game.Overview: You are the last remaining piece of a powerful fallen god. To protect yourself as a child, you must steal the three shards of the Triforce (Power, Wisdom and Courage) and hide in the Temple of Time, until such a time when you are strong enough to take on the ultimate evil! Throughout your travels, you will see that much has changed from the Hyrule you once knew. Many items and power-ups were stolen and relocated by an infamous band of thieves known as the Order of Chaos. Many of the treasures are sprinkled throughout the world, but some of the most valuable are kept in the arduous Riddle of Time dungeon. Can you find it?....Can you beat it?
Game.Genres: Action; Adventure; Beat 'em Up; Platform; Role-Playing

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Sands of Time
Game.Overview: Long after the events of the dark age, when the evil King Ganon ruled over the Kingdom of Hyrule who died of old age, a young adventurer and fairy rose up in the hope of gaining wealth and the power that Ganon once held to live a life that suited their own interests

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: South Island Adventure
The Legend of Zelda: The Missing Link
Game.Overview:
Covering The Legend of Zelda: The Missing Link, a new fan-mod of Ocarina of Time. The game takes place after OoT & before the events of Majora's Mask. It features all new areas, custom code, plus a new & remixed musical score. Game created by Kaze Emanuar, CDi-Fails, and /Zel/.
Credits: Game Planning and Level Design Kaze Emanuar
All 3D Models and Maps /Zel/ & CDi-Fails
Programming Kaze Emanuar /Zel/
Original Music Compositions Zerovolt0v A6stringthing Sauraen Badub DezZival
Cutscenes CDi-Fails /Zel/ OstrealavaO2 Sauraen

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: The Sealed Palace
Game.Overview: An Ocarina of Time Romhack. Lots of gameplay in various areas and dungeons with custom cutscenes, songs and much more. Good luck finding all 100 Skulltula tokens and 20 hearts!

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Time Lost
Game.Overview: A sequel to The Legend of Zelda â€“ Master of Time, that takes place 4 years after the events of Abello. Link finds himself on yet another adventure after settling down in a new country called Finlay, where he discovers the worship of Majora to the mystery of Jabu milk and much more.

Game.Name: The Legend of Zelda: Voyager of Time
Game.Overview:
Voyager of Time takes place after Majoraâ€™s Mask, but it is not a direct sequel. Link has come back to the Kokiri Forest to try and find peace after his last adventure. It is implied that he has had a third adventure in Termina but with the fairy Tael instead of Tatl. The younger brother of the feisty Tatl is a bit more subdued, but also more brave than what weâ€™ve seen in Majoraâ€™s Mask. He can hold his own and he and Link have grown to be great friends.
The game starts out with Link having nightmares of his past adventures. The Deku Tree Sprout, descendant of the Great Deku Tree has summoned Link because he has sensed great evil growing lately. Link is sent on a quest to help out with the growing problems in Hyrule.
Along the way, you find that the Door of Time has been broken again by the evil villain, Ganondorf, and you must find a way to stop his rampage once more. Thereâ€™s some twists and turns along the way, as Linkâ€™s items are spread out in an unfamiliar way. Link also has to face some major problems that hit a little too close to home.
The game features heavy time travel as well as side stories that highlight the problems with time traveling in general. Many places are transformed over the period of seven years that Ganondorf was in rule, and Link has to deal with the problems of his closest friends. On top of that, there may be another problem Link doesnâ€™t realize until itâ€™s too lateâ€¦

Game.Name: The New Tetris
Game.Overview: With special new moves, additional ways to score, and room for up to 4 players simultaneously, this already habit-forming classic will have you absolutely addicted! Perform a Spin Move to place that hard-to-fit piece. Can't use the shape you're given? Use the Hold Piece instead. Form Multi- and Mono-Squares, then clear them to make you score soar! You can even dump Garbage on your friends as you compete in multi-player mode.

Game.Name: The Patchmaker's Workshop
Game.Overview:
"One day, whilst crafting a plush doll, something miraculous occured. The doll smiled at me."
Mario awakes inside a charming workshop with a dark past, with Peach and Bowser transformed into plush dolls sitting beside him. They had all been attacked by a man named The Patchmaker... To save them, he needs to team up with a creation of that man, the living doll Sewnia. Embark across 12 different worlds, collecting a new ability in each that helps Mario traverse that area. What secrets does this workshop hold? What goals does The Patchmaker have? ...And how did Sewnia come to life exactly?
The Patchmaker's Workshop features a fully original soundtrack composed by ornevelder, Tori Draws Stuff, and CowQuack.

Game.Name: The Powerpuff Girls: Chemical X-Traction
Game.Overview:
The Powerpuff Girls must battle enemies in a variety of settings in order to reclaim Chemical X and track down Mojo Jojo.
In the story mode, players can pick up objects and throw them at an enemy to decrease their opponents health meter. They can use superpowered attacks by collecting vials of Chemical X. If the player successfully defeats the enemy in two out of three rounds, they move to the next enemy location.
Players can play the story mode or can battle against a friend in a head-to-head battle.

Game.Name: The Preservation Project
Game.Overview: The Preservation Project is a hack of Super Mario 64 created by Fluvian and Marionova which aims to recreate the Shoshinkai '95 build of the game. The hack was officially released on June 8th, 2022, by Fluvian, along with the source code. As of 2020, this hack appears to be one of the most accurate Super Mario 64 Spaceworld '95 beta remakes ever created.

Game.Name: The Quest For Milk 64
Game.Overview:
After going to the fridge to get a glass of milk, Mario discovers that he's ran out completely. So, Mario goes to the nearest convenience store to get more, but a major accident happens when he tries to get back home...
Help Mario through a short course, as he collects bottles of milk in order to awaken from this coma induced dream world.

Game.Name: The Soul of Legends
Game.Overview: The ancients spoke of a power so deadly and fearsome it had no choice but to be locked up forevermore, the culmination of the power of all the souls in the universe. The Legend Soul. The soul, the very essence upon which life is based. In the far off land of Draelin, power and souls are one and the same and if someone were to control the power of the soul they would hold dominion over the power of life itself. After receiving a vision of the cataclysmic destruction of Hyrule, Zelda sent her most promising knight, Link, to end it before it began by collecting the legendary ancient Soul.

Game.Name: The Super Mario Bros. Super Show 64
Game.Overview: Hey Paisanos! It's a hack based on the Super Mario Bros. Super Show!

Game.Name: The Swoop 64
Game.Overview:
You play as a crow who is building a nest from items scattered around the area. It plays like a flight simulator so itâ€™s fairly easy to grasp if youâ€™ve played that kind of game before.
The game takes place in a small village with a few houses, a picnic and a junkyard and you have to pick up and bring back items from around the stage back to your nest at the centre of the area.
At first you can only pick up balloons but as you start to return items back to the nest, you unlock the ability to pick up bigger and bigger objects.
Itâ€™s an arcade-style game so the objective is to try to obtain a high score, which is the height measured in feet of your ever-expanding nest.

Game.Name: The Violent Arts
Game.Overview:
The Violent Arts is an ongoing ROM hack for the Nintendo 64 game Virtual Pro Wrestling 2 (VPW2). The project focuses on modernizing the classic AKI engine by replacing original wrestling animations with highly detailed, custom-made movesets.
Project Features:
* Custom Animations: Features revamped moves like the V-Trigger, One Winged Angel, and Stylin' DDT, tailored to mimic the styles of modern wrestlers such as Kenny Omega and Will Ospreay. * Modern Roster: Includes modern wrestlers and factions, such as FTR and Swerve Strickland, within the retro N64 framework.

Game.Name: The Yoshi Garden
Game.Overview: Grow, Care for and play with your Yoshis! Breed your favourite Yoshi color and pit your Yoshis against each other in competitions! Based on the Chao Garden from Sonic Adventure.

Game.Name: Tigger's Honey Hunt
Game.Overview: Winnie the Pooh needs YOU! How can he throw a party without honey? Play as Tigger and run, jump, and bounce around the 100 Acre Wood in search of Pooh's "most favorite" snack. Along the journey there'll be plenty of challenges - blustery blowing leaves to ride, icy terrain, falling boulders, menacing bees, pesky bats and more. Earn Tigger's very special "Tiggertastic Bounce" as a bonus!

Game.Name: Tom and Jerry in Fists of Furry
Game.Overview: One-on-one fighting! Tag team tournaments! Just choose your character and then select the location. All the environments are modeled after scenes from your favorite Tom & Jerry episodes. An "All-Star" line-up of characters such as Tom, Jerry, Butch, Spike, Tuffy, and Duckling help to make this the ultimate Tom & Jerry experience! Weapons include shovels, bombs, red-hot pokers, tennis rackets, furniture and an assortment of fruit, plus there are countless other tricks, traps and surprises to be found. It doesn't get any better than this. So go to your corner, wait for the bell and come out fighting. Just keep an eye out behind you, because no one fights fair in this game!

Game.Name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Game.Overview:
Rainbow Six is a tactical shooter, which focuses more on stealth and tactics than on sheer firepower. To add to the realism, all in-game characters, terrorists, hostages and Rainbow operatives, can be wounded or dispatched in just fractions of a second. Tools such as thicker body armor, automatic rifles, and grenades have little value before the player grows accustomed to the gameplay.
Before each mission is a planning stage, during which the player is given a briefing, and then chooses the operatives to be involved in the mission, their weapons, equipment and uniform/camouflage. In earlier games, the player pre-established orders and waypoints during this step. The planning stage determined elements such as the path the AI-controlled squads would follow during the mission, as well as where they will deploy devices such as flashbangs or door breaching charges.

Game.Name: Tommy Thunder
Game.Overview: Tommy Thunder was a third person shooter in development for the Nintendo 64 (and later for the PSX too) from Player 1 studios, but it was never released and we never got many informations about it. In November 2007, herpetic.adventures on the LostLevels forum posted an interesting story about a misterious file: â€œ[â€¦] about 10 years ago I was poking around the Player1 website looking for info on when Robotron 64 was coming out. Just for the hell of it, I clicked the â€œPress Infoâ€ link. Which turned out to be an anonymous FTP. Woo. Poked around a bit, and amongst directories of PSX assets, I found robo64.zip and tommy64.zip.â€ Inside the zipped file, there was what it looks like an early prototype of Tommy Thunder 64

Game.Name: Tonic Trouble
Game.Overview: Trouble up to your bow tie! Ed's toxic goo turned the world crazy - tomatoes are rioting, carrots are biting back, and Grogh the Hellish wants Ed's head! Help Ed right the wrongs in 12 wildly animated worlds -insane puzzles, killer vegetables, dangerous dungeons, and more. All caused by Ed. It's the biggest trouble anyone has ever gotten into, or out of! A strange brew of action adventure and mind-bending puzzles!

Game.Name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
Game.Overview: Go Big, Go Pro! Skate as legendary Tony Hawk, or as one of nine top pros. Work your way up the ranks by landing suicidal tricks in brutal competitions to become the highest ranked skate champ! Great features such as: Signature Pro Moves, fully skateable worlds, head-to-head competition, and Instant Replay Mode.

Game.Name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2
Game.Overview: The sequel to Tony Hawk's Pro Skater adds many new tricks, while retaining those from the original, and a complete roster of the greatest skaters worldwide. Among the new tricks is the "manual", which allows the player character to balance on two wheels. There are also more options for scoring high-trick combos. Trick combinations can also be edited and customized. It is possible to visit some of the most popular skate parks in the world, or create own areas and share them with other players. Players can also create their own skaters, with a choice of clothing and official skateboards.

Game.Name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3
Game.Overview: You may not be able to live like the legend, but now you can skate like him. Skate as the legendary Tony Hawk or choose from a dream team of 12 top pro skaters, including old favorites like Lasek, Thomas, Muska, and Steamer, as well as new talent like Gilfberg, Caballero, Koston, and Mullen. Or enjoy full customization abilities with the enhanced Create-a-Skater (now including female skaters) and the Skatepark Editor. Travel from L.A. to Tokyo, Suburbia to Skater's Island performing challenges and meeting goals. New moves include the Revert, which allows you to link vert tricks, and flatland tricks such as Caspers, the Primo, and Handstand Manual. If you're good, you can even unlock hidden pro footage.

Game.Name: Toon Panic
Game.Overview: Toon Panic was a multiplayer brawler / arcade fighting game for Nintendo 64, in development at Bottom Up. It was meant to be similar to Power Stone or Rakugaki ShowTime, but it was later cancelled because of bankruptcy of the studio. A proto was sold some years ago on a japanese auction, and finally leaked to the public on the 3 December 2008, thanks to Team Carrot / No-Intro. â€œUnfortunately the game is far from being complete. There is a nice intro with cool music, no main game, a multiplayer mode but without IA and some debug features.â€ The Final Fantasy 8 images in the characters select screen were just placeholders.. a weird choice from the developers.

Game.Name: Top Gear Hyper-Bike
Game.Overview: Big air. Fast tracks. Snarling competitors. Whether you're into high-flying motocross racing or knee-scraping street bike action, Top Gear Hyper Bike opens the throttle on gritty, two-wheeled fun. Strap on your brain bucket and test these features: Four incredible modes of play, Track Editor to create your own mind-blowing tracks, race on the street and in the dirt using 16 authentic race bikes from Kawasaki, Yamaha and Honda, unlock hidden bikes and bonus courses by winning race seasons in Championship Mode.

Game.Name: Top Gear Overdrive
Game.Overview: Smile, you beast. It's the world's fastest multi-player N64 racing, geared for people who love to cheat! Oh yeah. This baby's got it all! Ten wild cars. Five white-knuckle tracks. A beautifully giddy selection of wicked hair-pin turns, roller coaster hills and secret, shifty shortcuts. Plus: 6 full vocal BGM tunes. Challenging Mirror Racing Mode. The world's worst weather conditions. And: IT'S OKAY TO CHEAT! Once you get ahead you stay ahead by forcing the competition into interactive objects like traffic cones and road signs. Waaay cool. The one and only Top Gear Overdrive. Don't get mad. Get evil!

Game.Name: Top Gear Rally
Game.Overview:
Top Gear Rally has you racing around a collection of high speed tracks, both on-road and off, with varying weather conditions and shortcuts to improve your times.
The cars available to race vary in speed, braking, acceleration and top speed rankings, and the more you complete in Championship mode, the better cars that are unlocked for you to race. You can also edit the cars paint scheme, including text and icons.
Single player and split screen multiplayer is supported.

Game.Name: Top Gear Rally 2
Game.Overview:
The second rally racer from Kemco on the N64 provides a vastly different style of rally racing to the original Top Gear Rally.
Along with the new option to join a rally racing team, who supports you through-out each championship cup you take part in. Money raised by each victory or top place in the cups goes towards improving your car, or repairing any problems. If you take a wrong turn and damage a part of your car (which can be anything from tires to a full engine), the repairs come out of your pocket. New sponsorship deals and bigger team call ups will also come into play the better you race, allowing the chance to drive the more powerful rally cars and play for big money.
You can also take part in the usual arcade rally style against 4 other cars, with the first to get to the finish taking the points. 2 players can play as part of one team during a championship campaign, as well up to four players split screen in the arcade mode.

Game.Name: Total Darkness
Game.Overview:
This mod features a lot of butchered meanings of text in both the menus and all of the UI related text popups. This romhack features full translated voice acting, some custom music and some custom translated textures.
Also includes some custom heads featuring David Doak etc, also some custom weapon models.

Game.Name: Tower & Shaft
Game.Overview:
Tower & Shaft: Aleck Bordon no Fuyukai na Nakamatachi is an enhanced remake of the Macintosh games NS-Tower and NS-Shaft bundled together into one game. Players control an adventurer Aleck Bordon, who is tasked to unseal the divine power of treasures hidden within two temples: Tower & Shaft.
In Tower, players hold and release a button to jump, while Aleck automatically moves left and right. It's important to release the button before Aleck falls off any of the platforms he's walking on and falling off the screen leads to a game over.
In Shaft, players can move Aleck left and right and the objective is to fall on the platforms below him. Losing this game is possible by falling off the screen or getting squished by the spikes above that descend on the player.
The game features a story mode and endless mode with high scores being saved only for the Endless mode.
This game is a hack/port from the Aleck64 Arcade to work on Nintendo 64.

Game.Name: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
Game.Overview: The Countdown to Adventure is On! As space hero Buzz Lightyear, you've got your hands full. Your best buddy, Woody, has been kidnapped by a greedy toy collector and it's going to be an all-out race against time to save him. It's all up to you... Buzz Lightyear to the rescue! Spin, spring, somersault and bounce through 15 colorful, action-packed levels. Unlock special toy accessories to complete your missions like cool rocket jet boots! Enjoy fast and fun 3D gameplay with your favorite characters from the movie!

Game.Name: Transcending the Rainbow
Game.Overview:
Transcending the Rainbow is a 182 star major kaizo hack developed by Serium, with a guest course from Amsixx.
Stop Bowser from Transcending the Rainbow in this consistently difficult kaizo, featuring a completely unique OST and custom RedMat collision types.

Game.Name: Transformers: Beast Wars Transmetals
Game.Overview: Now, experience a Transformers battle you've never seen before! Take command of the Heroic Maximals and Evil Predicons as they struggle for supremacy! More powerful than ever, these cybertronian warriors can convert into 3 modes: beast, vehicle, and robot. Run, blast and transform your way to victory! Crush the competition with the awesome Ultra Blast attack!

Game.Name: Traumatic Tick Tock Tower
Game.Overview: A reimagining of Tick Tock Clock, designed to train players in advanced Super Mario 64 mechanics.

Game.Name: Triple Play 2000
Game.Overview: This is POWER Baseball! Great game features such as: Full control hitting - more power, more contact! One-button baserunning! Fast-paced gameplay! Home Run Challenge! Multiple fielding cameras! Real-time lighting! Detailed facial animations!

Game.Name: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil
Game.Overview: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil is the sequel to Turok: Dinosaur Hunter. Having defeated the Campaigner, Turok throws the Chronocepter into a waiting volcano to destroy it. Unfortunately the blast awakens an even deadlier force - The Primagen - who lays in wait for his freedom from a wrecked space craft, buried at the core of the Lost Land. Once again a Turok is tasked with restoring peace to the land and stopping the Primagen from merging Earth with the nether world.

Game.Name: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion
Game.Overview:
When the Primagen's Lightship was destroyed in Turok 2: Seeds of Evil the resulting explosion created a shockwave throughout the universe. This effect nearly ended the life of Oblivion, a 'thing' that drifts through space, consuming anything that ends up in its way. Also during this explosion, a new world was created. In this world lies the Turok family tree, and Oblivion knows that the only way the pain the lies within can be stopped is to destroy the Turok line.
The third title in the Turok series allows you to choose who will become the successor of the Turok lineage, either Danielle Fireseed or her brother Joseph. Each has unique paths through the same levels, as Joseph's small size allows him to fit into air ducts to take the low road, while Danielle's magnetic grappling hook allows her to take the high road. Each also has unique upgrades to basic weapons. While Danielle's shotgun upgrade coats the shrapnel in napalm to immolate anything they touch, Joseph's instead charges them with electricity, causing them to ricochet off of walls and floors. The story is told through in-game cutscenes with highly detailed models. There are no keys to collect this time around, as each level leads linearly into the next.
Turok 2's multiplayer mode returns, and includes the ability to add computer controlled bots. Each playable character in multiplayer mode has a unique set of weapons they can use.

Game.Name: Turok: Dinosaur Hunter
Game.Overview: Turok: Dinosaur Hunter is a first-person shooter with platforming and light puzzle-solving elements. Much of the game is set in outdoor environments, and requires the player to explore them by finding various paths, jumping, swimming, and climbing. The game's most notable enemies are dinosaurs of various sizes, though the levels also include human and demonic enemies, as well as wildlife. The player gradually gains access to thirteen weapons (plus the Chronoscepter, assembling which is the game's main objective); these include a knife, a bow, as well as high-tech firearms such as a rocket launcher and an atomic fusion cannon.

Game.Name: Turok: Rage Wars
Game.Overview: Since time began, Turok has maintained the balance between good and evil with the Light Burden. A vessel that holds the power of creation. Now, fierce wars are fought for control. You must prove yourself worthy to wield the Light Burden. You must relive the challenge of your ancestors and survive the RAGE WARS! Featuring brutal heart-pounding deathmatches, lethal weapons with unimaginable power, and 8 savage game modes, including co-op mission-based gameplay, Team Bloodlust, Frag Tag and more!

Game.Name: Twisted Edge: Extreme Snowboarding
Game.Overview: This is it! The fast-paced, intense snowboarding action you've been waiting for! TWISTED EDGE: EXTREME SNOWBOARDING! The sickest tricks, the biggest air and runs you've only dreamt about 'til now. No more searching for the best ride ever, grab your controller and prepare to get twisted! Loaded with riders, boards, and secrets - each with their own unique qualities. There's lots available, but only if you aren't slackin' off in your ridin' skills! Performance is everything and it pays off in TWISTED EDGE!

Game.Name: Ultimate Goomboss Challenge
Game.Overview:
Saving the world is hungry work. With the Star Rod recovered, a satisfied Mario and Goombario head out for a bite to eat. But who's this in their favourite picnic spot? And more importantly, can you come up with a strategy to defeat...
Made as a love letter to RPG boss battles, and a determination to make the most epic possible final product using only Goombas.

Game.Name: Ultimate Trial
Game.Overview: Deep inside the Lost Woods lies a mysterious Stronghold, inhabited by lost travelers. As Link enters this place, he is greeted by Shiba, the protector of the fortress. He places the task of conquering the 3 Trials upon Link. He needs to meet new people and explore each corner of the Stronghold to be prepared, but will he be able to conquer them all and eventually reach the Ultimate Trial?

Game.Name: Utchan Nanchan no Hono no Challenger: Denryuu Ira Ira Bou
Game.Overview:
Utchan Nanchan no Hono no Challenger: Denryuu Ira Ira Bou is a puzzle game for the Nintendo 64 released only in Japan in 1997. It is based on a segment of the Japanese game show Utchan Nanchan no Hono no Challenger: Kore ga Dekitara 100 Man En!!
The game follows the same playing principle as the mechanical wire loop game. In this variant, the player has to guide a ball through six courses which basically consist of narrow ways with curves and obstacles. The player is not allowed to touch anything and has to solve the course within a time limit.

Game.Name: Vena Kart 64
Game.Overview: Vena Kart 64 is a mod featuring 7 custom tracks and 9 ports from other Mario Kart games. The developer created 13 of the tracks, while the other 3 were made by Diego Vapy.

Game.Name: VeteranEye
Game.Overview:
A mod for the GoldenEye veterans!
Imagine if GoldenEye had a 4th difficulty after 00 Agent that was not 007? This would be it. The mission atmospheres are different, with new skyboxes and music added to most levels to give it a different vibe. This mod is intended for GoldenEye veterans, hence the name. It will take a new approach to complete levels, which can throw even the most skilled of players off guard. There are hidden secrets in places which can make the mission easier, or you can skill it out and brave it without them. The cheat times are even changed to fit the new level design, so that's another challenge!

Game.Name: Viewpoint 2064
Game.Overview:
Viewpoint 2064 was a 3D vertical shmup being developed by Racdym to be published by the series owners Sammy Corporation. It was a sequel to the original Viewpoint which released in 1992.
Viewpoint 2064â€™s first known announcement was in August 1999, when Nintendo announced their Space World August 1999 lineup. The game was playable at both Space World and the September 1999 Tokyo Game Show. In Nintendoâ€™s Space World guide book, it was given a half page advertisement and was listed as 100% complete, set for a November 11th, 1999 release date for Â¥7,800.
When IGN64 did their Space World 1999 coverage, on August 27th, 1999, they reported that Sammy was in talks with several International publishers, but that no US release date was currently planned. Despite being listed as 100% complete Viewpoint 2064 was not simply delayed to Q1 2000, but disappeared completely soon after the show with some magazines and websites stating it had been canned. However, a year later on August 14th, 2000, IGN reported that Viewpoint 2064 was scheduled to appear at the upcoming Tokyo Game Show and was set for a November 24th release date. It was listed on the organisationâ€™s Computer Entertainment Supplierâ€™s Association (CESA) website, also with a release date of November 24th, 2000, for a then undecided price.
Meanwhile, Tsutaya, a chain of book and video rental stores, posted Viewpoint 2064 for sale on their website. This listing had a release date of November 17th, 2000, some preliminary box art, and a description of the game. All this information makes it likely that other retailers had been informed about the upcoming release as well, but Viewpoint 2064 did not hit this date, and by 2001 the game had been quietly cancelled.
Out of all of the versions of Viewpoint that were released, Viewpoint 2064 was the only one that was developed as a true sequel, with entirely different levels, mechanics, graphics, progression, and a story.
