No official reason for cancellation was given.

Game.Name: Vigilante 8
Game.Overview:
Vigilante 8 is a vehicular combat game similar to Twisted Metal in concept. Players can choose from eight characters with different agendas, and select vehicles ranging from classic 1970's muscle cars to a school bus, each stacked high with various kinds of weapons. Unlockables include two hidden levels (three in the Nintendo 64 version) and five hidden characters and cars. Multiplayer is also included: the Nintendo 64 version allows four players to go head-to-head.
The game takes place in the Western United States during a time of world-wide oil shortage in 1976. An organization known as OMAR (Oil Monopoly Alliance Regime) was making money off the shortage everywhere except in the United States. OMAR hires the best terrorist that $100 million could buy: Sid Burn. His job, aided by five hired Coyotes, is to destroy all gas refineries in the southwest of the U.S. so OMAR can bring the country to its knees. When gas prices went wild, six civilians who called themselves Vigilantes, led by the truck driver Convoy, began fighting against the Coyotes in different areas to keep OMAR from succeeding.

Game.Name: Vigilante 8: 2nd Offense
Game.Overview:
More drivin' & blastin' fun in this sequel to Vigilante 8. The Coyotes gang returns with a shocking new leader to seek revenge on OMAR, and the Vigilantes gang.
New cars, weapons and landscapes add new excitement to the game. There are 18 charcters with storylines to walk through, which in turn affects the other characters in the game, and how well you do in the single player missions will determine what happens in the later levels.

Game.Name: Virtual Chess 64
Game.Overview: Transform your N64 into a powerful chess adversary. The most awesome chess engine adapts to any skill level. Learning is endless fun yet even superb players face the maximum challenge. Brilliant graphics brings this classic game alive. Become the next chess legend!

Game.Name: Virtual Pool 64
Game.Overview: The ultra-real physics make Virtual Pool 64 as close to real pool as it gets! Choose from 9 types of pool including favorites like 9-Ball, Straight Pool, 8-Ball and One Pocket. Three levels of difficulty: Amateur, Professional and Championship. Master trick shots, learn a new game or challenge hundreds of computer opponents in exciting tournament play.

Game.Name: Virtual Pro Wrestling 2: Freem Edition
Game.Overview: Virtual Pro Wrestling 2: Freem Edition is a hack of AKI Corporation's Virtual Pro-Wrestling 2 on the Nintendo 64. The hack replaces various default VPW2 wrestlers with other wrestlers, most of whom have been in other AKI wrestling games. Unlike most other AKI wrestling game modding projects, the changes in VPW2 freem Edition are made by editing the ROM, meaning the resulting hack can be played on real hardware.

Game.Name: Virtual Pro Wrestling 2: Nihon No Tsua
Game.Overview:
This mod for Virtual Pro Wrestling 2 sees the arena's mat and aprons replaced with real world companies All Japan Pro Wrestling (Budokan), New Japan Pro Wrestling (Tokyo Dome Ramp), Frontier Martial Arts Wrestling (Tokyo Dome), Michinoku Pro (Korakuen Hall), IWA Japan (Kawasaki Stadium)
Also included are some new CAW parts, like Vader's black mask, the Can-Am Connection's trunks, and Tajiri's blue and white trunks. Everything that needs to be unlocked in the vanilla rom is locked here, and will require you to play through and unlock things as normal.
The turnbuckle pads have been switched to the corner cushions seen in NJPW, IWA Japan, and FMW. The colors on the pads are inverted, if anyone wants to correct this, I'd greatly appreciate it, and would gladly add you as a contributor to the mod. Unfortunately, seeing as the turnbuckle pads are a global change, it isn't possible to give AJPW and Michinoku Pro their correct pad type.

Game.Name: Virtual Pro Wrestling 2: Oudou Keishou
Game.Overview:
The sequel to Virtual Pro Wrestling 64, and released only in Japan. The title translates to Royal Road Succession; the name of the career mode in the game. The fifth wrestling game developed by AKI Corporation. Contained many improvements from previous titles that would be featured in AKI's final Nintendo 64 wrestling game WWF No Mercy. Some features, such as creating masks in edit mode and the MMA style grappling system, would not be carried over to WWF No Mercy.
Virtual Pro Wrestling 2 carries the All Japan Pro Wrestling license, and features 21 wrestlers from their promotion. The rest of the characters included in the game are based on other real promotions and wrestlers, but due to copyright have fake names and appearances. This is common among other Japanese wrestling games. You can identify who the other wrestler's are by their unique moves and taunts, and the edit mode contains each piece of ring attire you would need to recreate their actual likeness.
In total, there are 98 wrestlers in the game, 23 of which have to be unlocked. There is also 16 original character slots you can use to edit and create your own wrestlers, bringing the potential total of wrestlers in the game to 114. This game has the largest roster of all of AKI's wrestling games. In comparison, WWF No Mercy would have 64 wrestlers available.

Game.Name: Virtual Pro Wrestling 64
Game.Overview:
In this sequel to Virtual Pro Wrestling, wrestlers worldwide gather once again to fight it all out. The game has many similarities to WCW vs. nWo: World Tour. The new roster contains a total of 78 real-life wrestlers from seven different organizations, plus 16 unlockable legends. In addition, the player has the ability to customize a wrestler cosmetically and statistically. The game plays in six different modes:
â€¢ Champion Road - From six different wrestling organizations, the player must beat all opponents who hold the champion title to become top champion. â€¢ Exhibition - This can be played in single, tag team, or handicap matches. Game rules are configurable. â€¢ Elimination - With a group of five select wrestlers, the player battles in team matches against an opposing group of five. â€¢ Battle Royale - Four wrestlers fight simultaneously in the ring with the last man standing being the winner. â€¢ League - With a total of 16 wrestlers as tag teams, the player must beat every single team to get the highest in the league. â€¢ Tournament - 16 different wrestlers battle in 8 bracket structured matches for the highest ranking.

Game.Name: Virtual Pro Wrestling 64 Deluxe
Game.Overview: The definitive version of Virtual Pro Wrestling 2, featuring all new wrestlers, moves, enhanced entrances, entrance themes and so much more! Featuring wrestlers from WCW, WWF, NJPW, AJPW, Michinoku Pro and Indies.

Game.Name: Virtual Pro-Wrestling Salvo
Game.Overview:
Virtual Pro-Wrestling Salvo is a ROM hack of WCW/nWo Revenge, created by RagDas.
Features include: * 11 new characters, including Ric Flair (originally planned for Revenge) and nWo Sting (dummied out of the final game) * All DAW and EWF characters converted to their real identities * Imported moves and taunts from later games * Running Special Grapples un-dummied (hold Control Stick while running when you have a Special; certain characters only) * New edit mode costume items

Game.Name: V-Rally Edition 99
Game.Overview: Racing insanity! Over 40 original tracks, 11 official World Rally Championship cars, tracks in 8 worldwide locations, realistic race physics and smooth car handling, diverse terrain such as jungles, canyons, deserts, mountains and more, unstable weather patterns like rain, fog, snow and cloudy. Adjust car performance characteristics to suit varied road conditions. Bonus and hidden cars and tracks to unlock!

Game.Name: Wado Vice 64
Game.Overview: Short hack with 1 level themed around 80s, inspired by Peach's Fury. It has a ranking system for replayability and a timer. It is a hack perfectly suited for speedrunning.

Game.Name: Waialae Country Club: True Golf Classics
Game.Overview: One of the most beautiful golf courses in the world is now one of the most beautiful N64 games. The true physics of golf take the starring role in this ultra-realistic venture into the popular sport. You can customize the characteristics of up to 10 different golfers, including power, putting, recovery, and ability against the wind. Plan your approach, pick a club, get your stance just right, read the wind, decide whether you're going for spin, draw or fade, read the meter to get your power where you want it then swing! The six modes of play at your disposal are Waialae Open, Tournament, Stroke, Skins, Match, and Practice. A truly comprehensive game, WAIALAE COUNTRY CLUB will even calculate your handicap for you for use in later play. Up to four players can have a go in each game, with all stats and results saved to the game's memory. The graphics and player animations are outstanding, the play is seamless and intuitive, and the location just can't be beat. Spend your next vacation in Waialae, golf fans. Just don't expect it to be easy.

Game.Name: Waluigi's Taco Stand
Game.Overview: Waluigi has gambled himself into bankruptcy. In order to pay for his rent, there is only one solution, selling tacos! And not just regular ones, help Waluigi cook the tacos that will give the most profit for this unique adventure. Bon apetit!

Game.Name: War Gods
Game.Overview: War Gods is a one-on-one fighting game that takes place in 3D environments. The fighter under your control can perform many different moves, and string those moves together to perform "combos." Furthermore, the fighters all have special "finishing moves" that eliminate your opponent in some gruesome manner at the end of a match. There are 10 different fighters to choose from, all based on different ancient civilizations.

Game.Name: Wario's Hint Art
Game.Overview: One day, Mario recieved a strange package from his good buddy, Wario. The package contained a rude letter, along with a folder of several weird drawings and photos. Looks like Wario's up to no good - can Mario find the stolen Stars with Wario's Hints? And what's he up to, anyway?

Game.Name: Water Star Adventure
Game.Overview: A mysterious world where those devout to dorrie live. Unique takes on what it means to be a "water level", or just a mario level in general, are presented as your skills are put to the test. Explore 3 traditional style, and 4 new experimental levels where water does not act like it normally does. Made for the first iteration of the scuttle rom hack competition, where each participant only had 56 hours (7 days) to create a 30 star hack. This hack was not judged with the rest of the hacks as it was created by the competition organizer.

Game.Name: Wave Race 64
Game.Overview:
"Wave Race 64" is a 1996 racing video game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. It is the second entry in the "Wave Race" series, following the 1992 Game Boy game "Wave Race". Gameplay involves racing a personal watercraft across a variety of courses while manoeuvring around buoys. The game also includes a multiplayer mode in which two players can compete on a selected course. It supports the Controller Pak, which allows saved data to be transferred between game cartridges. The game is presented in a letterboxed 14:9 aspect ratio.
The game was initially conceived as "F-Zero on water" and was intended to feature high-speed transforming boats. These were later replaced by personal watercraft after producer Shigeru Miyamoto concluded that the original concept would not be sufficiently distinct from other games on competing systems. "Wave Race 64" received positive reviews from critics, particularly for its controls and dynamic water environments, and has subsequently been included in lists of highly regarded video games. The game also served as an early showcase for the Nintendo 64's 3D graphical capabilities following Nintendo's earlier 2D-focused titles for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System. It was re-released for the Wii and Wii U through the Virtual Console in 2007 and 2016, respectively, and was added to the Nintendo Classics service in 2022. A sequel, "Wave Race: Blue Storm", was released for the GameCube in 2001.

Game.Name: Wave Race 64 Shindo Pak Taio Version
Game.Overview: This is a re-release of WaveRace 64 Kawasaki JetSki with added Rumble Pak features. Part of the Japan-only Shindou Edition series.

Game.Name: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey
Game.Overview: Tear up the ice with "The Great One", and experience lightning-fast skating, blistering one-timers and hard-hitting body checks! Hammer the puck and rip the net... with the world's best! NHLPA and NHL license means real players, team names, logos, and uniforms. Includes all 26 teams, each with 17 available players in their actual NHL lines. Real-time rendered 3D environment with 7 user-selectable cameras allowing players to view the action from all possible angles. Wayne's hockey strategies, skating moves and logic are incorporated into the AI engine.

Game.Name: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Game.Overview: Take on "The Great One" again in this hot sequel to the smash hit voted "Best Sports Game" of '96! With more great features, such as new hidden teams and improved, hard-hitting AI, Gretzky '98 packs a wallop! Includes all 26 teams, each with 17 available players on their actual NHL teams, and you can make player trades or line manipulations to create a powerhouse team of your own. Play 3-on-3, 4-on-4 or 5-on-5 games on either arcade or regulation size hockey rinks, plus exhibition games, full 82 game seasons or a best-of-seven playoff series with full statistic saving capability.

Game.Name: WCCW 64
Game.Overview: WCCW 64 is a free mod of the Nintendo 64 videogame WWF No Mercy. It is based on the entire lifespan of the 80's Wrestling organization World Class Championship Wrestling.

Game.Name: WCW Backstage Assault
Game.Overview:
WCW Backstage Assault is a professional wrestling video game by Electronic Arts. It was the final World Championship Wrestling (WCW) game released before the company was purchased by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF).
WCW Backstage Assault takes over 50 WCW wrestlers out of the ring and into real-world venues like a locker room, garage and a loading dock. Traditional wrestling moves can be used, but weapons like two-by-fours and trash cans are also thrown into the mix. By working your way through the game's various modes, you can unlock additional wrestlers, areas and weapons. Bobby Heenan and Tony Schiavone provide the commentary with over 8,000 lines of dialogue.

Game.Name: WCW Feel the Bang
Game.Overview: WCW Feel the Bang! is an extensive ROM hack of WWF No Mercy for the Nintendo 64, created by a large group of modders and posted on the AKI Live forums. The game acts as a fan-made sequel to WCW/nWo Revenge. It features a very large cast of wrestlers, many WCW arenas, custom movesets, and an unlock system.

Game.Name: WCW Mayhem
Game.Overview:
WCW Mayhem is based on Ted Turner's hit cable wrestling league World Championship Wrestling. The game takes many of it's wrestlers and combines them with authentic moves, settings, and actual events found on the various cable programs and pay-per-view specials.
"Mayhem" is probably an accurate word to describe the first wrestling game from Electronic Arts. A TV-style presentation features play-by-play commentary along with signature entrances enhanced by pyrotechnics and theme music. Over 50 professional wrestlers from World Championship Wrestling are included, although you'll need to play through the "Quest for the Best" mode to unlock them all.

Game.Name: WCW Nitro
Game.Overview: Go for the gold, as you take on the Superstars of WCW and the NWO in Singles, Tag Team or Battle Royale competition! Set the stage - Fight in arenas from WCW's biggest events, including WCW Monday Nitro, Starrcade, and Halloween Havoc. Plus, TONS of hidden arenas, secret "run-in" characters, Nitro theme music, and brawling in and out of the ring! Who's next? You are, when you step into the ring with WCW Nitro, the fastest wrestling game to hit your N64! Take control of over 60 WCW and NWO Superstars! Dozens of devastating moves per wrestler, including trademark maneuvers, taunts, and finishers!

Game.Name: WCW/nWo Revenge
Game.Overview: More than 60 wrestlers, including ALL of the top WCW and NWO superstars! Awesome new features including wrestler entrances, all the real WCW belts, hidden weapons, instant replay, completely updated roster and complete user stats and arcade style scores! Enjoy real pay-per-view arenas, 40-man Battle Royale mode, and a costume editing feature!

Game.Name: WCW/nWo Revenge Redux
Game.Overview: Revenge with entrance music. No other changes aside from ROM, RAM and file table expansion for modders.

Game.Name: WCW-nWo Revenge: Starrcade Edition
Game.Overview:
This is an unofficial, fan-made, not-for-profit fan modification of WCW/nWo Revenge on the N64, fully compatible with Emulation, Summercart, Everdrive, and Console.
Texture upgrades, fictional stables & wrestlers replaced, new characters added/roster expanded, over 200 ported and custom move/taunt animations, every playable character now has 4 unique, real attires, and custom sound effects/announcer clips.

Game.Name: WCW/nWo REVENJI
Game.Overview:
WCW/nWo REVENJI is the first ROM hack of WCW/nWo Revenge, developed by RagDas, primarily known for being a Korean translation of the original game.
EWF has been replaced by AJPW, and the DAW roster has also been converted, meaning the following roster changes have been made to the game:
* Kenta Kobashi (replaces Executioner) * Toshiaki Kawada (replaces Shogun) * Jumbo Tsuruta (replaces Dr. Frank) * Dr. Death (replaces Jekel) * Akira Taue (replaces Maya Inca Boy) * Genichiro Tenryu (replaces Hawk Hana) * Koji Kitao (replaces Kim Chee) * Atsushi Onita (replaces Dake Ken) * Kodo Fuyuki (replaces Brickowski) * Tarzan Goto (replaces Ming Chee) * Tiger Mask (replaces Han Zo Mon) * Masahiro Chono makes his official return from the roster of WCW vs. The World! He possesses the vast majority of his moves from Virtual Pro Wrestling 64, and occupies the final slot of DAWâ€¦at the expense of Virgil.
To round out the AJPW roster, Terry Gordy was added, who can now officially tag with Dr. Death! His moveset is heavily based on Steve Williamsâ€™, with certain moves reflecting Gordyâ€™s VPW2 moveset. He replaces Sonny Onoo.
Wrath is more complete. What does that mean? No more glitched Snake Eyes or Boston Crab and an actual costume of his own (at the expense of Mortisâ€™).
Nitro has been converted into a facsimile of the â€˜lostâ€™ arena from VPW2.

Game.Name: WCW Saturday Night
Game.Overview: WCW Saturday Night is a ROM hack of WWF Wrestlemania 2000 for the Nintendo 64. The mod covers the early 1990's of WCW wrestling and includes an entirely new roster, along with custom arenas and newly added themes/music.

Game.Name: WCW Saturday Night Remastered
Game.Overview: * Restored CAW Slots (WCW Saturday Night SK 1.2 has 7 caw slots, remastered restores all 16) * 18 New Wrestlers (in addition to base WCWSN SK1.2 roster, a first for a WM2000 romhack) * New Main Menu & Edit Mode BGMs * 80 new selectable entrance theme songs (110 themes total now) * Several new parts for CAW makers to make wrestlers that didn't make the cut * Upgraded graphics for all wrestlers, including new face textures and new/upgraded attires * â€˜98 Tag Title replaced with era appropriate tag title. US Tag Team titles added * Handful of new moves and very very minor moveset changes * And more!

Game.Name: WCW vs. nWo: 9 Underground
Game.Overview:
WCW vs. nWo: 9 Underground is a ROM hack of WCW vs. nWo - World Tour, created by RagDas. In his own words:
"Here's my second ROM hack of WCW vs. nWo: World Tour, titled "WCW vs. nWo: 9 Underground". This time around, it's quite simple to summarize what was achieved: 9 wrestlers, as the name suggests, have been added to the playable roster without removing anyone from the existing roster. It is known among a few people who have explored ROM hacking World Tour that the moveset and params data for entire playable roster of VPW64 is contained within World Tour, though for characters that didn't make the final roster of World Tour, their movesets are in various states of completion. This hack has taken 9 of these incomplete characters and given them full functionality."

Game.Name: WCW vs. nWo: World Tour
Game.Overview: Over 40 wrestlers in all, including over 20 WCW and NWO superstars like Hollywood Hogan, Sting, The Giant, Lex Luger, Ric Flair, The Outsiders and many more! Each wrestler is capable of performing 30 to 40 moves, including his own signature moves! Featuring five different gameplay modes, Tag Team and simultaneous four-player action!

Game.Name: Wetrix
Game.Overview: A rainstorm so fierce, it will keep you from leaving your home for the next six months. Wetrix just might be the most addictive puzzle game of all time. Using randomly shaped 3D blocks as they fall from the sky, you must create a series of lakes and dams before the heavy rains appear. Because if the water drains, you lose! Sound simple? Well, mix in a few natural disasters and bomb attacks, and suddenly you need to muster all your strategy and skill to combat nature's fury!

Game.Name: Wheel of Fortune
Game.Overview:
This game is an interactive version of the popular U.S. quiz show Wheel of Fortune complete with hostess Vanna White.
The game is played by trying to find a hidden word with only a few guesses allowed for the letters which is very similar to the pen and paper game Hangman. The other round which features the Wheel of Fortune involves you spinning the wheel which has various prizes both good and bad and whatever the pointer stops on when it stops revolving is what the player wins. This can be cash, a free spin or if you're very unlucky Bankruptcy which means you lose all the money you've earned up to that point.
Up to 3 Players can play together in multiplayer mode.

Game.Name: Whomp's Fortress
Game.Overview: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time: Whomp's Fortress is a compact, fan-made ROM hack that perfectly transposes the iconic second stage of Super Mario 64 into the Ocarina of Time gameplay engine. Playing as young Link, you navigate the familiar floating fortress using traditional Zelda mechanics, substituting Mario's platforming and Power Stars for puzzle-solving, combat, and item-based exploration. The mini-dungeon challenges players to explore every vertical layer of the map to discover a hidden key, unlock a secret room, and track down 10 Golden Skulltulas for 100% completion.

Game.Name: Wildwaters
Game.Overview:
Wildwaters (also know as â€œExtreme Kayakâ€ and â€œX-Streamâ€) is a cancelled racing game that was in development by Looking Glass Studios for the Nintendo 64 in 1998 / 1999. The project was announced at E3 1999 by Ubisoft (that was interested as a publisher) while the studio was working on Destruction Derby 64 (published in the same year), but sadly it was never finished.
Wildwaters 64 was very promising as Looking Glass were able to create an engine with real physics running for the waterflow through the river on an N64, but it needed more time and love which eventually ran out. Five different gameplay modes, including Arcade, Time Trial, Championship, Finals and Versus Battle were planned for the game.
Some months later, on May 2000, Looking Glass Studios went out of business during a financial crisis related to their publisher at the time, Eidos Interactive. Wildwaters / Extreme Kayak vanished forever, along with their other promising N64 racing game, Mini Racers.
There was another cancelled water racing game titled â€œWild Water World Championshipsâ€ that was planned for the Nintendo 64, but it should not be confused with this one as WWWC was developed by Promethean Designs.

Game.Name: WinBack: Covert Operations
Game.Overview: A terrorist group calling itself the Crying Lions is about to take over the world with its mighty satellite and Jean-Luc Cougar is the only one who can stop it. As Jean-Luc, a covert operative working for the Strategic Covert Actions Team, you are responsible for taking back a Lions-controlled base and regaining power of the satellite. Some of the weapons you'll have to acquire and use to defeat the terrorists are handguns, shotguns, and machine guns, though you'll also need to access such materials as explosives, detectors, flashlights and medical kits in order to succeed. A refreshing take on the traditional action game, WINBACK requires as much stealth and strategy as it does reflexes and use of weaponry. The game features six different multiplayer modes, supporting up to four players: Death Match, Lethal Tag, Quick Draw, Cube Hunt, Team Battle, and Point Match. You select your difficulty level and you can even start off in a Tutorial mode to get the controls down.

Game.Name: Wipeout 64
Game.Overview: WipEout 64 was released by Psygnosis as a follow-up to the racing game WipEout XL, taking place one year later in 2098. Like in previous installments players control highspeed hovercrafts, pick up weapons to damage the opponents' vehicles and try to finish the race in the first position. In many aspects, the gameplay is pretty similar to its predecessor, such as selection of hovercrafts, visuals or the handling system. Beside new racing tracks the main differences include a Split-Screen Multiplayer Mode (up to four players), Weapon & Super Combo Challenges as well as various Special Weapons for each Team!

Game.Name: Wizard of the Board
Game.Overview:
It is a shitty time. The harvests are poor, and monsters roam freely across the land. Chosen by lot, warriors are trained from birth in the mystic artes. A warrior must be learned in cunning, strategy, and swiftness for their final lonesome trial when they come of age. To prevail as a warrior is to scale the Demon's Spire, lair of the Shadow Queen. Many have entered, but few have returned. If one prevails over the trial, if one succeeds at their task, they shall be known as a Wizard of the Board.
Wizard of the Board is my submission to the second N64Brew Game Jam. It was made over the course of two months and runs on a retail Nintendo 64. The theme for the game jam was "control". My natural answer to that was first-person voodoo chess.
You can play the game with a Nintendo 64 flashcart. Most emulators should work too, such as Ares or mupen64plus.
The premise of the game involves Zatt, a young warrior-in-training. Zatt aims to scale the Demon's Spire and become a Wizard of the Board. Or, at least he thinks he does.

Game.Name: Wonder Project J2: Koruro no Mori no Jozet
Game.Overview:
Wonder Project J2 is a Japanese exclusive Nintendo 64 game released in 1996 as a sequel to the 1994 Super Famicon game Wonder Project J. Wonder Project J2 was developed by Givro and published by Enix.
The game takes place 15 years after the events of the first game and focuses on the protagonist Josette - a female robot built by Doctor Geppetto who built the main character of the previous game as well. The game plays as a raising simulator, with the player guiding Josette through the text driven game through yes or no questions in a branching but limited story line. Choices made in the early game effect the outcome of the second half as Josette and by proxy the player come into conflict with the Silliconian Army.

Game.Name: World Cup '98
Game.Overview: Win the World - For Your Country! All 32 World Cup France 98 qualifying teams: Take your team, with all your favorite players, to the World Cup Final and win it all. NEW! World Cup Classics: Play 8 of the all-time most thrilling World Cup Final matches. NEW! On-the-fly in-game management: Alter attacking strategy and formation at the press of a button. NEW! On-the-fly in-game tactics: Run preset plays at critical points in the game.

Game.Name: World Driver Championship
Game.Overview: World Driver Championship allows players to develop a racing career as they compete for job offers with each of the 15 World Driver Teams. The game features 10 tracks (Sydney, Kyoto, Rome, and others), 20 challenging events spread across two different levels of competition, and over 30 exotic cars. The game strives to imitate realistic physics and car handling.

Game.Name: Worms Armageddon
Game.Overview: 'Dis ain't no fishing game. The ultimate test of strategy pits worm vs. worm throughout 44 missions for 1 - 4 players. Ignite 41 special weapons, like highly flammable old ladies, bouncy banana bombs, and flying sheep, as you inch your way to victory. Devise wickedly ingenious strategies so that your army of worms can wipe THEIR army of worms right off the planet! Over-the-top action and an endless supply of multi-player modes make Worms Armageddon the perfect strategy game!

Game.Name: WWE Wrestlepalooza
Game.Overview: WrestlePalooza 64 refers to a popular community mod/ROM hack of the classic Nintendo 64 game WWF No Mercy. It upgrades the legendary AKI game engine with massive roster updates, high-resolution textures, custom entrance music, and improved Artificial Intelligence (AI) for more competitive and fluid in-ring matches.

Game.Name: WWF Attitude
Game.Overview: Now featuring over 40 of your favorite WWF superstars! Customize your own wrestler's move sets and costumes. Over 20 game modes including all-new specialty matches. Real-life WWF entrances and theme songs. Wrestle your way to the title in an all-new career mode. First ever Create-Your-Own Pay-Per-View Mode! Two-man commentary featuring Shane McMahon and Jerry "The King" Lawler.

Game.Name: WWF Backlash
Game.Overview:
26 years later, the long awaited sequel to WWF No Mercy has arrived, courtesy of RetroRandyPrice.
WWF Backlash is an extensive ROM hack of No Mercy, with many new features, including:
* New wrestlers, each with their own trons and entrance themes * New arenas * New match types, such as Hell in a Cell, Multi-man Cage and Barbed Wire matches * New moves * New gameplay mechanics, such as tossing over the top rope, and powerbombs over the top rope
Play out the Invasion angle in all it's glory. Backlash has arrived!

Game.Name: WWF Eras: The New Generation
Game.Overview:
The Hogan Era is over. The muscle-bound giants are fading. What rises in its place is faster, rawer, more personal, and itâ€™s all here in WWF Eras: The New Generation, the second game in the series.
Rather than a traditional front-loaded roster dump, this game is built around a pod-based system. Each pod is headlined by a major WWF superstar of the time, and surrounded by their greatest rivals, allies, and storyline-specific matchups, giving you a fully immersive timeline from WrestleMania IX to the dawn of the Attitude Era.
This is the era of Bret Hart, The Undertaker, Shawn Michaels, Diesel, Razor Ramon with new blood rising from every corner. Each pod tells a story. Each rivalry can be played. Every feud you remember (and some you forgot) is in your hands.
About WWF ERAS: The New Generation
Unlike a typical front-loaded roster dump, The New Generation is thoughtfully built around a Pod System where each pod is centered on a featured superstar from the era. These pods are timeline-accurate and organized by key rivalries, storylines, and affiliations that defined WWF from 1993â€“1997.
From Bret Hartâ€™s legendary battles with Owen Hart and Jerry Lawler, to Razor Ramonâ€™s Intercontinental title wars, to Shawn Michaelsâ€™ rise to the boyhood dream, this game lets you relive the entire arc of the New Generation through carefully curated rivalries and character matchups.
Each pod feels like its own chapter in WWF history, making this more than just a game... itâ€™s an actual playable timeline.

Game.Name: WWF Hulkamania 64
Game.Overview: Hulkamania 64 brings together the full rosters from WWF Saturday Nightâ€™s Main Event and WWF Prime Time, along with several Federation-era superstars who were missing from both games. It also restores more than 20 wrestlers from GMSpectreâ€™s WWF WrestleMania X hack. That means more legends, more matchups, and plenty of room to recreate your favorite years of the WWF.

Game.Name: WWF Legends
Game.Overview:
WWF LEGENDS is a complete modification of the beloved Nintendo 64 video game "WWF No Mercy" originally released in 2000 and widely regarded as one of - if not the best professional wrestling simulation ever created. The AKI (now Syn Sophia) Development team were able to take the colorful and unique world of professional wrestling and lovingly port it directly into their multiple titles for the Playstation and Nintendo 64 throughout the late 90s/early 2000s culminating in this game, the final release of its kind. Because of its reputation as the "gold standard" in pro-wrestling gaming, and made stronger by the sudden stop in production, wrestling and video game fans alike have longed for more of the signature action and quirkiness AKI games provided.
By that same token, the World Wrestling Federation (now WWE) was king of the world of professional wrestling in the mid-80s well into the 90s. Dubbed the "Golden Era," the colorful characters, legendary performances, pop-culture crossover success and indelible childhood memories created in this time period has left a generation of fans clamoring for a way to relive the glory days of the WWF.
WWF LEGENDS aims to fill both of these voids and appeal to multiple generations by updating and evolving the AKI game engine while capturing the essence of the World Wrestling Federation's golden age. The marriage of these two worlds almost serves as a spiritual successor to "WWF WrestleFest" - the classic arcade title that fans of the era will certainly remember. This is all made possible through emulation - WWF LEGENDS runs on Project64, an emulator available for your PC. A variety of other tools help create the immersive experience including custom music, match commentary & more.

Game.Name: WWF No Mercy
Game.Overview: Jump into the ring with the biggest, baddest jambronis around and experience brutal WWF action never before seen in a console game! Over 65 WWF superstars, all-new Ladder matches, and all-new Double-Team moves, like the Dudley 3D Deathdrop! Take on the entire Federation in Survival Mode. Take the action out of the ring in 10 different backstage areas!

Game.Name: WWF No Mercy Plus
Game.Overview:
WWF No Mercy Plus is a ROM hack of WWF No Mercy for the Nintendo 64, created by RetroRandyPrice along with contributions from @thejordyad. The mod aims to improve the base version of No Mercy in several ways, including:
* Big Show replaces Steven Richards (Richards is moved to another slot) * Full wrestler entrances * Improved quality entrance themes, along with 17 additional entrance songs * Move additions, including the Rock's Sharpshooter and Kurt Angle's Ankle Lock
Version 1 was released in July 2023, with plans for additional versions in the future.

Game.Name: WWF Prime Time Wrestling
Game.Overview:
WWF Prime Time Wrestling is a total conversion of WWF WrestleMania 2000 for the Nintendo 64.
What began as a single project celebrating WWF's Golden Era grew into a dual release (along with WWF Saturday Night's Main Event). The projects were built from GM Spectre's WWF WrestleMania X SK 1.2 base and were strongly influenced by the WWF Legends Challenge 64 texture hack.

Game.Name: WWF Saturday Night's Main Event
Game.Overview:
WWF Saturday Night's Main Event is a total conversion of WWF WrestleMania 2000 for the Nintendo 64.
What began as a single project celebrating WWF's Golden Era grew into a dual release (along with WWF Prime Time Wrestling). The projects were built from GM Spectre's WWF WrestleMania X SK 1.2 base and were strongly influenced by the WWF Legends Challenge 64 texture hack.

Game.Name: WWF War Zone
Game.Overview: The game features seven basic gameplay modes, allowing configurations of one to four players. These include training mode, one-on-one, tag team, cage match, weapons match, tornado tag team, and war (elimination free for all). Two additional modes, Royal Rumble and gauntlet, are exclusive to the Nintendo 64 version. The player can also create and customize his own wrestler, taking him through the WWF challenge. The new wrestler finds himself at the bottom of a pyramid, and has to challenge wrestlers situated immediately above him, gradually working his way through to the title. Sometimes previously defeated wrestlers will challenge the player to a "grudge match", which usually consists of special encounters, such as battles with weapons or cage matches.

Game.Name: WWF WarZone!
Game.Overview: WWF WarZone 64 is a ROM hack of WWF No Mercy. The concept is envisioned as AKI, the original creators of No Mercy, undertaking WWF WarZone. The game features custom arenas, superstars from the '98 era, training rooms, and hi-res textures.

Game.Name: WWF WarZone: Badd Blood
Game.Overview:
This is a total conversion of WWF Wrestlemania 2000 for N64 as what originally started as a project of "what if AKI released WWF WarZone instead of Acclaim". It has turned into the teams love letter to such a popular time period in wrestling fans' minds.
WHAT HAS CHANGED FROM ORIGINAL WWF WM2000 ---------------------------- - Wrestlers moveset, stats, appearances changed - Entrance Music changed - All Arenas changed - Intro updated - All Tag Team entries changed - Spotlights, Fireworks, Fire have been reworked to be as fitting as possible.Â - Menu graphics changed - Moves imported - Story mode text changed - Title belt graphics and info changed - Hints added to title screen for unlockables - Match graphics changed - In Game menus and Graphics Changed

Game.Name: WWF WrestleMania 2000
Game.Overview: The greatest wrestling game ever created! Tons of game modes, including Cage Match, Road to Wrestlemania, Create a PPV, and more! Create and bet WWF Championship belts with your friends. Over 50 of the top WWF superstars, more than any other WWF game! Thousands of signature moves, taunts, and mannerisms. New Create a Wrestler, with custom moves, costumes, and fighting styles!

Game.Name: WWF Wrestlemania X 64
Game.Overview:
WWF Wrestlemania X 64 is a total conversion of WWF Wrestlemania 2000 N64, with the premise of "What if there was a WWF AKI game released in the early 90's that was based on the rosters of the 16 bit games?"
List of changes:
* All characters moves, stats, appearances changed * All music changed * All Arenas changed * Intro animation changed * All Tag Team entries changed * Spotlights, Fireworks, Fire on all entrances altered * All Titantrons changed * Menu graphics changed * Entrance music plays on title and in match instead of midi music * Moves imported * Story mode text changed * Introduction cutscene edited. * Title belt graphics and info changed * Hints added to title screen * Select backgrounds for wrestlers match * Power bar graphics changed * Font changed to VPW2 font

Game.Name: Xena: Warrior Princess: The Talisman of Fate
Game.Overview: Xena shall choose the defenders of the world. We have seen them in the memories of her exploits. So come together, Earth's greatest heroes and villains. Choose your weapons wisely and let the battles begin! Just remember, each victory only brings you closer to challenging the embodiment of darkness... Despair himself! Each of Xena's 10 characters possess their own unique weapons, attitudes and fighting techniques. Exclusive multi-player feature includes a roster mode, plus team and single battles.

Game.Name: Xeno Crisis
Game.Overview:
Xeno Crisis is an arena shooter in which one or two players take control of battle-hardened marines embarking on a deadly mission to confront an alien menace and get home alive! Run and gun your way through thousands of adversaries as you explore the devastated research outpost, searching for survivors, and ultimately facing the origin of the outpost's demise.
Outpost 88 is divided into seven distinct areas, each being randomly generated with each play, meaning that your strategy must evolve on the fly if you're to succeed in your mission. Collect dog-tags from vanquished enemies to upgrade your equipment between areas and look out for special weapons which will give you a momentary advantage.
â€¢ A faithful port of the hit 16 bit game with added extras. â€¢ Incredible pixel art from the legendary pixel artist, Henk Nieborg. â€¢ Intense FM chiptune soundtrack by Savaged Regime, originally created for the YM2612! â€¢ Two difficulty levels and three modes of play. â€¢ An arsenal of 10 weapons to master. â€¢ Play solo or local co-op with a friend!

Game.Name: Xibalba 64
Game.Overview: Xibalba 64 throws you into a maze of high-tech bases, ancient catacombs, and dense jungle corridors inspired by classic '90s shooters. Armed with heavy firepower, you battle through the Mayan underworld against relentless enemies and environmental hazards. Blocky low-poly visuals and a moody ambient soundtrack define the experience, blending old-school intensity with modern precision. Fast movement, sharp gunplay, and oppressive atmospheres drive every encounter.

Game.Name: X'treme Roller
Game.Overview: Cancelled Nintendo 64 port developed by Titus Software. It did, however, make a retail release on the PlayStation 1 in PAL regions. This build is very early and contains no sound effects or music, with only two playable areas.

Game.Name: Yakouchuu II: Satsujin Kouro
Game.Overview:
Yakouchuu II: Satsujin Kouro is the sequel to the text adventure game, Yakouchuu, released for the Super Famicom in 1995. Yakouchuu GB was also released in 1999 for the Game Boy Color.
The story of Yakouchuu II takes place at sea. After a ship has been attacked, players must investigate what happened.

Game.Name: Yoshi's Adventure 128: Attack of the Factory
Game.Overview: After losing Bowser in an attempt to stop him from his monthly chores, Yoshi has realized that his base has polluted one of the valleys it inhabited. Oil leaked out and is pouring down into Oil Valley! Yoshi must... stop it to finally defeat Bowser for that cheap cliffhanger! And also there's music at the final boss where Bowser is. Yay!

Game.Name: Yoshi's Racing Story
Game.Overview: *Mod that features Yoshi as a playable racer. Green Yoshi replaces Timber and Red Yoshi replaces TT. Red version has TT stats for more speed and is a smaller scale. It also has 4 brand new levels in a Yoshi universe theme. *Car/hover/plane vehicles are supported for Yoshi. With an update I'd like to add levels to correspond with them. More levels to come to go with Hover and plane also. Soon. *There is also a "Yoshi Only" version which will not have any new levels here: Coming very soon.

Game.Name: Yoshi's Story
Game.Overview: Baby Bowser has taken the Super Happy Tree and cast a spell on Yoshi's world, turning it into the pages of a picture book. The only Yoshis not affected by the spell were six hatchlings that were still protected by their shells. It's up to them to reclaim the Super Happy Tree and restore happiness to the world. That is the only thing that can break Baby Bowser's Spell!

Game.Name: Zelda 64: Dawn & Dusk
Game.Overview:
Zelda 64 - Dawn & Dusk is a brand new disk expansion for The Legend of Zelda - Ocarina of Time.
It is NOT meant to be a recreation of Ura Zelda or Zelda Gaiden, it has been purposefully made to show off the capabilities of Zeldaâ€™s 64DD support by hackers. There is a patch that can be applied to play the ROM on a Nintendo 64.

Game.Name: Zelda 64: The Cursed Mansion
Game.Overview: A mod of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time made by Recardo for the Horror Competition (2024) on the Hylian Modding website.

Game.Name: Zelda Indigo
Game.Overview: Indigo is an in-progress mod for Ocarina of Time that aims to be a full game replacement, with new items, enemies, bosses, maps, and story. Play as the Hero of Time following the events of Majora's Mask in the child timeline! The story is set 27 years after the events of MM. There are currently two public demos. If you want to play Chapter 1, there is a link to it on the releases page. It's not as polished or fleshed out as Chapter 2, but there's still some unique content there for those interested!

Game.Name: Zelda's Birthday
Game.Overview: This is a hack for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (MQ) Debug ROM. It features all new actor arrangements, all new text and story line, 3 totally redesigned dungeons, an optional side quest, endings(plural), and hidden goodies.

Game.Name: Zool: Majuu Tsukai Densetsu
Game.Overview:
Zool is a JRPG based around Monster collecting, taking clear influences popular series like Dragon Quest and PokÃ©mon. The word Zool is meant to be a combination of Zoo and School.
The story opens with the orphan 10 year old main character, named Leo by default, finding a hatched baby monster of a rare breed in the forest. It follows him home so he keeps it and and names it ãƒãƒ¼ãƒ‹ã‚£(BÄnyi or Bernie) by default. Monsters and humans generally live together, but there are friendly competitions held each year to decide the best monster battler, with these competitions drawing in more legendary rare monsters which are desirable for the villains. The first plotline conflict is Leo is pursued by Roche, a rare monster collector and his 2 henchmen Matt & Mitt who try to steal his new friend, with more characters and villains showing up throughout the game.
The game is split into two main sections, towns and the overworlds/dungeons segments. Inside towns players move a cursor around to select which building they want to visit, there is no free roam in these sections. Towns consist of the many homes and taverns of villagers who must often be talked to in order to progress the storyline, shops for buying and selling items, various houses and inns to save progress and heal, and monster daycares for players to store monsters they collect. Exiting a town brings players to the overworld where random battles occur and new towns, dungeons, and other landmarks that can be reached by foot. At certain points players enter labyrinthine 3D dungeons where the players can walk up to doors, treasure items, and must find their way to the end. Keys must be found in item bags, desk drawers, or chests.
Battles are automatic with monsters making their own choices after a small period of time passes. Players can only blow their whistle to directly order a monster, which costs musical notes on the bottom of the screen which regenerate over time.

Platform.Name: Nintendo 64
Platform.Display: Up to 480i (576i PAL region), also widescreen
Platform.Notes:
Named for its 64-bit central processing unit, it was released in June 1996 in Japan, September 1996 in North America, March 1997 in Europe and Australia, September 1997 in France and December 1997 in Brazil.
As part of the fifth generation of gaming, the N64 competed primarily with the PlayStation and the Sega Saturn. The Nintendo 64 was launched with three games: Super Mario 64 and Pilotwings 64, released worldwide; and Saikyo Habu Shogi, released only in Japan.
While the N64 was succeeded by Nintendo's MiniDVD-based GameCube in November 2001, N64 consoles remained available until the system was retired in late 2003.
